```{r diffBetweenGroups, results='asis', fig.height=18, fig.width=8}
      cat("\n")
      
      gg <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_for_alluvials,
                   ggplot2::aes(x = Time, stratum = dir, alluvium = variable))+
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(ggplot2::aes(fill = dir), width = 1/2, alpha = 1/2,) +
        ggalluvial::stat_stratum(ggplot2::aes(stratum = dir, fill = dir), width = 1/2) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = curr_color_df$color)+
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(geom = "text", ggplot2::aes(label = variable), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + ## to label NA category
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(geom = "text", ggplot2::aes(label = variable, color = dir), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
        
        ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = curr_color_df$outline)+
        ggplot2::theme_bw()+
        ggplot2::labs(fill = paste0("MW ",groups_to_compare$group2," vs ",groups_to_compare$group1))
      
      plot(gg)
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("alluvial, only not diff at baseline"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      df_for_alluvials2 <- df_for_alluvials %>%
        ##make wider 
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Time", values_from = "dir") %>%
        ## remove rows with Baseline diff
        dplyr::filter(Baseline == "not_sig") %>%
        ### back to only
        tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Time", values_to = "dir") %>%
        ### remove Basline rows since all not_sig
        dplyr::filter(Time != "Baseline") %>%
        ## factorize
        dplyr::mutate(Time = factor(Time, intersect(tps_for_thisSet,unique(Time))),
                      dir = factor(dir, c("up, p < 0.05","up, p < 0.1","not_sig","down, p < 0.1","down, p < 0.05")),
                      variable = factor(variable)) %>%
        ## arrange
        dplyr::arrange(dir, variable)
      
      
      gg <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_for_alluvials2,
                   ggplot2::aes(x = Time, stratum = dir, alluvium = variable))+
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(ggplot2::aes(fill = dir), width = 1/2, alpha = 1/2,) +
        ggalluvial::stat_stratum(ggplot2::aes(stratum = dir, fill = dir), width = 1/2) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = curr_color_df$color)+
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(geom = "text", ggplot2::aes(label = variable), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + ## to label NA category
        ggalluvial::stat_alluvium(geom = "text", ggplot2::aes(label = variable, color = dir), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
        
        ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = curr_color_df$outline)+
        ggplot2::theme_bw()+
        ggplot2::labs(fill = paste0("MW ",groups_to_compare$group2," vs ",groups_to_compare$group1))
      
      plot(gg)
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
    }
    
    
  }else{
    
    
    cat(paste0("no variables with ",curr_ds,"\n"))
    cat("\n")
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  
  
  ### save pvalues 
  
  list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",stringr::str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_diff_",curr_ds)]] <- p_value_df1 %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable_comp_time")
  
  
  
  
  
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  
  
  
}
```

```{r suppTable, results='asis'}
hex_to_rgba <- function(hex, alpha = 1) {

  sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.3f)", rgb[1, ], rgb[2, ], rgb[3, ], alpha)
}

  blend_with_white <- function(hex, alpha) {
  # hex: character vector of "#RRGGBB"
  # alpha: numeric vector in [0,1] same length as hex
  stopifnot(length(hex) == length(alpha))

  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)              # 3 x N
  alpha <- pmin(pmax(alpha, 0), 1)            # clamp

  # apply alpha per column
  blended <- sweep(rgb, 2, alpha, `*`) + sweep(matrix(255, 3, ncol(rgb)), 2, (1 - alpha), `*`)
  blended <- round(blended)

  sprintf("#%02X%02X%02X", blended[1, ], blended[2, ], blended[3, ])
}
```

```{r AssocWithTOA, results='asis', fig.height=20, fig.width=18}
### for each dataset type

for(curr_ds in ds_to_use){
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_ds," {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat('\n')
  
  
  Corr_name <- paste0(Corr_name_base,"_",curr_var_set,"_",curr_ds)
  
  ## full_df only has the variables in columns and the factorized group (plus any other covariates if they are in the model)
  
  full_df <- curr_phen_long %>%
    ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
    dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable, !!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
    ## move comp and timepoint to var
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                  var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                  Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                  variable = NULL) %>%
    ## make wider
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = all_of(curr_ds)) %>%
    ## remove columns with only NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
    ### add in group & TOA
    dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID","TOA_adj",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                       dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                       ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                       dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                       dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                       ungroup(), 
                     by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
    ### factorize group
    dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
      names(group_colors_to_use),
      unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
  
  
  #### only if have any variables with same animals as TOA
  if(dim(full_df)[2] > 2){
    
    ### for each group separately
    ### prep to collect
    corr_df_combo <- data.frame()
    
    for(curr_group in names(group_colors_to_use)){
      
      
      #curr_df1: rows = samples, columns = variables
      #curr_df2: rows = samples, columns = TAO
      
      
      curr_df1 <- full_df %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(TOA_adj, Group_f))
      
      curr_df2 <- full_df %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(TOA_adj) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(TOA_adj = as.numeric(TOA_adj))
      
      ########## do correlation with psych package since much faster
      sp <- psych::corr.test(as.matrix(signif(curr_df1,7)), as.matrix(signif(curr_df2,7)), method = cor_method,
                             use="pairwise",
                             adjust="none",ci=FALSE)
      
      cor_mat <- sp$r
      cor_test_mat <- data.frame(sp$p)
      
      ## adj p for multiple comparisons by BH over assays
      cor_test_adj_mat <- cor_test_mat #duplicate dataframe to replace values
      for(curr_assay in colnames(curr_df1)) {
        cor_test_adj_mat[curr_assay,] <- p.adjust(cor_test_mat[curr_assay,], method = "BH")
      }
      
      
      #### also combine to dataframe since only one columns
      corr_df <- dplyr::left_join(data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column() %>%
                                    dplyr::rename(R_value=TOA_adj),
                                  data.frame(cor_test_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column() %>%
                                    dplyr::rename(raw_p=TOA_adj),
                                  by = "rowname") %>%
        dplyr::left_join(data.frame(cor_test_adj_mat) %>%
                           rownames_to_column() %>%
                           dplyr::rename(adj_p=TOA_adj),
                         by = "rowname") %>%
        ### add columns
        dplyr::mutate(
          ### set R_value to NA if p is NA i.e there were only 2 datapoints, some how the R is calculated but the p is not
          R_value = ifelse(is.na(raw_p),NA,R_value),
          dir = ifelse(R_value > 0 & raw_p < 0.05,
                       "up", 
                       ifelse(R_value < 0 & raw_p < 0.05,
                              "down","not_sig")),
          Time = str_after_last(rowname, "__"),
          var_comp = str_before_last(rowname,"__"),
          Group = paste0(curr_group)) 
      
      
      corr_df_combo <- rbind(corr_df_combo, corr_df)
      
    }
    
    ### if FC or delta, remove baselines
    if(curr_ds != "amount"){
      corr_df_combo <- corr_df_combo %>% 
        dplyr::filter(Time != "Baseline")
    }
    
    ### save stats
    list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",Corr_name_base,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_",
                          substring(curr_ds,1,2) ## trim to 2 letters since too long for excel tab name
    )]] <- corr_df_combo
    
    # saveRDS(corr_df_combo, file = file.path(outputRData_dir, 
    #                                                               paste0(Corr_name,"_", cor_method,"_CoefPvals_untrimmed.rds")))
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    ################## now plot sig correlations for all groups
    
    
    
    if(length(group_colors_to_use) == 2){
      #### set low/high range
      low_range <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_low",
                              DNA=as.numeric(1),
                              ALVAC=as.numeric(1))
      
      
      high_range <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_high",
                               DNA=as.numeric(1),
                               ALVAC=as.numeric(1))
      
      
      
      
      low_Rrange <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_low",
                               DNA=as.numeric(-1),
                               ALVAC=as.numeric(-1))
      
      
      high_Rrange <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_high",
                                DNA=as.numeric(1),
                                ALVAC=as.numeric(1))
    }else{
      #### set low/high range
      low_range <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_low",
                              studyA1=as.numeric(1),
                              studyA2=as.numeric(1),
                              studyB=as.numeric(1),
                              studyC=as.numeric(1),
                              studyD=as.numeric(1),
                              studyE=as.numeric(1),
                              #studyF=as.numeric(1)
                              )
      
      
      high_range <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_high",
                               studyA1=as.numeric(1),
                              studyA2=as.numeric(1),
                              studyB=as.numeric(1),
                              studyC=as.numeric(1),
                              studyD=as.numeric(1),
                              studyE=as.numeric(1),
                              #studyF=as.numeric(1)
                              )
      
      
      
      
      low_Rrange <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_low",
                               studyA1=as.numeric(-1),
                              studyA2=as.numeric(-1),
                              studyB=as.numeric(-1),
                              studyC=as.numeric(-1),
                              studyD=as.numeric(-1),
                              studyE=as.numeric(-1),
                              #studyF=as.numeric(-1)
                              )
      
      
      high_Rrange <- data.frame(rowname="range_set_high",
                                studyA1=as.numeric(1),
                              studyA2=as.numeric(1),
                              studyB=as.numeric(1),
                              studyC=as.numeric(1),
                              studyD=as.numeric(1),
                              studyE=as.numeric(1),
                              #studyF=as.numeric(1)
                              )
      
      
    }
    
    
    
    
    cor_test_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only R values
      dplyr::select(rowname,raw_p,Group) %>%
      ## replace NaN with na
      dplyr::mutate(raw_p = ifelse(is.nan(raw_p),NA,raw_p)) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group",values_from = "raw_p") %>%
      
      column_to_rownames() %>%
      ## filter to only vars that are sig in at least one group
      dplyr::filter_at(vars(everything(.)), any_vars(. < 0.05)) %>%
      rownames_to_column() %>%
      #### add dummy row to set square size range
      add_row(low_range) %>%
      add_row(high_range) %>%
      column_to_rownames() %>%
      as.matrix() 
    
    cor_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only R values
      dplyr::select(rowname,R_value,Group) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group",values_from = "R_value") %>%
      ### filter to only sig vars
      dplyr::filter(rowname %in% rownames(cor_test_mat_for_plot)) %>%
      #### add dummy row to set square size range
      add_row(low_Rrange) %>%
      add_row(high_Rrange) %>%
      column_to_rownames() %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    
    
    
    if(length(which(cor_test_mat_for_plot <  as.numeric(ann_pval_level))) == 0){
      
      
      cat(" ",paste0("no variables with p < ",ann_pval_level),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      
    }else{
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0(" corrplot"),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      #### otherwise can use the stars
      corrplot::corrplot(cor_mat_for_plot, method = 'square', 
                         is.corr = FALSE, #since not symmetric
                         p.mat = cor_test_mat_for_plot,
                         sig.level = as.numeric(ann_pval_level), 
                         insig='label_sig',  #set p < 0.05 to blank
                         pch.cex = pch_cex, pch.col = 'white',tl.col = 'black',tl.cex=tl_cex,
                         ##legend
                         cl.ratio = cl_ratio, #cl.cex = 2,
                         #addCoef.col ='grey80', 
                         #number.cex = 0.5, #add corr coeff to sig circles
                         #order = order, ## CANNOT ORDER ASSYMMETRIC
                         col = colorRampPalette(c("gold4","white","seagreen4"))(200), ### change colors so don't match DNA
                         # col = (COL2('PuOr',1000)), ##make orange NEGATIVE
                         col.lim = c(-1,1) ##set limits to be the same across plots
                         # title = vaccine_groups[i], mar=c(0,0,1,0) # http://stackoverflow.com/a/14754408/54964
      )
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0(" scatterplots {.active}"),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      ##### select which assays from which are sig assoc with TOA in at least one group
      
      if(length(group_colors_to_use) == 2){
        ### make corr_df_combo wider
        corr_df_combo_wide_tr <- corr_df_combo %>%
          ## remove redundant columns
          dplyr::select(-Time,-var_comp) %>%
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group",
                             values_from = c("R_value","raw_p","adj_p","dir")) %>%
          ### remove rows where dir is same for both groups
          dplyr::filter(dir_DNA != dir_ALVAC)
      }else{
        ### make corr_df_combo wider
        corr_df_combo_wide_tr <- corr_df_combo %>%
          ## remove redundant columns
          dplyr::select(-Time,-var_comp) %>%
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group",
                             values_from = c("R_value","raw_p","adj_p","dir")) %>%
          ### trim to only sig in at least one group
          dplyr::filter(rowname %in% rownames(cor_test_mat_for_plot))
      }
      
      ######## collect data to plot
      df_to_plot <- full_df %>%
        ## trim to only sig vars
        dplyr::select(!!!rlang::syms(c(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname,"TOA_adj","Group_f"))) %>%
        ### make longer
        rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !c(Sample_ID,TOA_adj,Group_f), 
                            names_to = "var_comp_time",
                            values_to = "value") %>%
        ## make TOA numeric
        dplyr::mutate(TOA_adj = as.numeric(TOA_adj)) %>%
        ### add in ALFQA
        dplyr::left_join(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID","Group_simp","Sex","studyLetterForMS")]) %>%
                           dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)),
                         by = "Sample_ID") %>%
        ### factorize
        dplyr::mutate(ALFQA_only = factor(str_after_first(Group_simp,"_"),
                                          c("Alum","ALFQA")),
                      Group_simp = NULL,
                      Sex = factor(Sex, c("Male","Female")),
          ### combined adjuvant x sex factor for shape (matches diffBetweenGroups)
          AdjSex = factor(paste0(as.character(ALFQA_only),"_",as.character(Sex)),
                          names(adjSex_shape_vec)),
          ### is this variable's timepoint Baseline? (per-variable, since var_comp_time encodes timepoint)
          is_baseline = grepl("__Baseline$", var_comp_time),
          ### per-point fill/border following shared scheme
          pt_fill = get_point_fill(Group_f, is_baseline, group_colors_to_use),
          pt_border = get_point_border(Group_f, is_baseline, group_colors_to_use)
        )
      
      
      
      
      
      list_of_plots <- list()
      plotted_data_df <- data.frame()
      
      
      for (i in corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname){
        #### trim to only this variable
        curr_df_to_plot <- df_to_plot %>%
          dplyr::filter(var_comp_time == i)
        
        ### set title for y axis
        y_line1 <- str_replace_all(str_before_first(i,"__"),"_"," ")
        y_line2 <- str_replace_all(str_after_first(i,"__"),"__",", ")
        
        
        
        if(length(group_colors_to_use) == 2){
          #### for by DNA/ALVAC group
p <-  ggplot(curr_df_to_plot, aes(y = value, 
                                  x = TOA_adj))+
            #scale_fill_manual(name = paste0("Vaccine (color)"), values=group_colors_to_use) + 
            #scale_shape_manual(name=paste0("Adjuvant (shape)"), values=c(Alum=21,ALFQA=24)) +
            scale_color_manual(name = paste0("Vaccine (color)"), values=group_colors_to_use) +
            
            geom_smooth(aes(color = Group_f), se = FALSE, method = "lm")+
            
            # geom_point(aes(fill = Group_f, shape = ALFQA_only), 
            #            color =  "black", size = 5, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.8, cex = 3)+
            
              geom_point(aes(shape = AdjSex), 
                       fill = curr_df_to_plot$pt_fill,
                       color = curr_df_to_plot$pt_border,
                       size = 5, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.9, cex = 3)+
            scale_shape_manual(name=paste0("Adjuvant/Sex (shape)"), values=adjSex_shape_vec) +

            
            # ### for exponent formatting
            #    scale_y_log10(breaks = trans_breaks("log10",function (x) 10^x),
            #                  limits = c(as.double(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]][i,"limit_y_low"]),
            #                                             as.double(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]][i,"limit_y_high"])),
            #                  labels = trans_format("log10",math_format(10^.x)),
            #                  ## for no expansion beyond limits
            #                  expand = c(0,0))+
            
            
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,12),
                               limits = c(0,12),
                               ## for no expansion beyond limits
                               expand = c(0,1))+
            
            ylab(paste0(y_line1,"\n",y_line2))+
            labs(title = paste0("DNA: R = ",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_DNA"]),2),
                                ", p = ",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_DNA"]),2)),
                 subtitle = paste0("ALVAC: R = ",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_ALVAC"]),2),
                                   ", p = ",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_ALVAC"]),2)))+
            theme_bw()+
            #### change color in legend for fill to have shape that can fill
            #guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)))+
            
            theme(legend.position="right", 
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.border = element_blank(), 
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black",lineend = "square"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
                  plot.title =  element_text(size = 15, color = group_colors_to_use[1]), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, color = group_colors_to_use[2]),
            )
          
        }else{
          ###### for byStudy
          
          
          
          p <-  ggplot(curr_df_to_plot, aes(y = value, 
                                            x = TOA_adj, fill = Group_f))+
            scale_fill_manual(name = paste0("Study (color)"), values=group_colors_to_use) +  
            scale_shape_manual(name=paste0("Adjuvant (shape)"), values=c(Alum=21,ALFQA=24)) +
            scale_color_manual(name = paste0("Study (color)"), values=group_colors_to_use) +
            
            geom_smooth(aes(color = Group_f), se = FALSE, method = "lm")+
            
            geom_point(aes(fill = Group_f, shape = ALFQA_only),

            # ### for exponent formatting
            #    scale_y_log10(breaks = trans_breaks("log10",function (x) 10^x),
            #                  limits = c(as.double(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]][i,"limit_y_low"]),
            #                                             as.double(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]][i,"limit_y_high"])),
            #                  labels = trans_format("log10",math_format(10^.x)),
            #                  ## for no expansion beyond limits
            #                  expand = c(0,0))+
            
            
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,12),
                               limits = c(0,12),
                               ## for no expansion beyond limits
                               expand = c(0,1))+
            
            ylab(paste0(y_line1,"\n",y_line2))+
            labs(title = paste0("studyA1: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyA1"]),2),
                                ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyA1"]),2),
                                ":  studyA2: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyA2"]),2),
                                ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyA2"]),2),
                                ":  studyB: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyB"]),2),
                                ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyB"]),2)),
                 
                 subtitle = paste0("studyC: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyC"]),2),
                                   ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyC"]),2),
                                   ";  studyD: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyD"]),2),
                                   ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyD"]),2),
                                   "studyE: R=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"R_value_studyE"]),2),
                                   ", p=",signif(as.double(corr_df_combo_wide_tr[which(corr_df_combo_wide_tr$rowname == i),"raw_p_studyE"]),2))
            )+
            theme_bw()+
            #### change color in legend for fill to have shape that can fill
            guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)))+
            
            theme(legend.position="right", 
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.border = element_blank(), 
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black",lineend = "square"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
                  plot.title =  element_text(size = 7#, color = group_colors_to_use[1]
                  ), 
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7#, color = group_colors_to_use[2]
                  ),
            )
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        }
        p1 <- p
        list_of_plots[[i]] <- p1 + theme(legend.position="none")
        
        
        
        cat("\n")
        cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
        
        plotted_data_df <- rbind(plotted_data_df, curr_df_to_plot)
        
      }
      
      ### get the legend
      #https://stackoverflow.com/questions/13649473/add-a-common-legend-for-combined-ggplots
      g_legend<-function(a.gplot){
        tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(a.gplot))
        leg <- which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
        legend <- tmp$grobs[[leg]]
        return(legend)}
      
      ### empty filler
      # list_of_plots[[nrow(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]])+1]]<-ggplot() + theme_void()
      # list_of_plots[[nrow(list_of_subsets_for_plotting[[paste0(set)]])+2]]<-g_legend(p1) ### grabs from the last plot
      list_of_plots[[nrow(corr_df_combo_wide_tr)+1]]<-g_legend(p1) ### grabs from the last plot
      
      ### fill out to at least 9 empty plots 
      if(length(list_of_plots) < 12){
        for(curr_missing in (length(list_of_plots)+1):12){
          list_of_plots[[curr_missing]] <- ggplot() + theme_void()
        }
        
      }else{
        list_of_plots <- list_of_plots
      }
      
      do.call("grid.arrange",c(list_of_plots, ncol=num_columns_for_plot))
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      list_of_plotted[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",Corr_name_base,"_",curr_ds)]] <- plotted_data_df
      
      
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      
      
      
    }
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    
  }else{
    cat(" ",paste0("no variables with same animals as TOA"),"\n")
    cat('\n')
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  
  
}
```

```{r AssocWithSelf, results='asis', fig.height=50, fig.width=15}
  }

  if(dim(full_df)[2] > 1){

        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      
      ########## do correlation with psych package since much faster
      sp <- psych::corr.test(as.matrix(signif(curr_df1,7)), method = cor_method,
                             use="pairwise",
                             adjust="none",ci=FALSE)
      
      cor_mat <- sp$r

                                  data.frame(cor_test_mat) %>%

        ### add columns

    )]] <- corr_df_combo

    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    ################## now plot sig correlations for all groups
    
    
    
    
    cor_test_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,raw_p,Group) %>%

      dplyr::mutate(raw_p = ifelse(is.nan(raw_p),NA,raw_p)) %>%
```

```{r vsADCCEff_prep}
cor_method <- "spearman"
Corr_name_base <- "VsADCCEff"

#### for corrplots
ann_pval_level <- 0.05
cl_ratio <- 0.5
pch_cex <- 2
tl_cex <- 0.8

###### for scatterplot
num_columns_for_plot <- 3


### trim to only the variables for this fig
curr_phen_long <- phen_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% list_of_vars[[paste0(curr_var_set)]]) %>%
  ### remove naive animals
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))


levels_vars_to_use <- c("Pct_CD14_efferocytes","Arif_ADCC_NCI05specific")
deltaFC_vars_to_use <- c("Pct_CD14_efferocytes","engulfing_capabiluity_MFI_CFSE")


#### collect ADCC & Eff to compare to
full_df_compare <- phen_long %>%
  ### first collect levels vars
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% levels_vars_to_use) %>%
  ### remove naive animals
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
  ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
  dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,amount)) %>%
  ## move comp and timepoint to var
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                variable = NULL) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(var_comp_time) %>%
  ## make wider
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "amount") %>%
  ## remove columns with only NA
  dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
  
  #### add in FC for FC vars
  dplyr::full_join(phen_long %>%
                     ### first collect levels vars & remove baseline
                     dplyr::filter(variable %in% deltaFC_vars_to_use & Time_Point != "Baseline") %>%
                     
                     ### remove naive animals
                     dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
                     ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
                     dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,FC)) %>%
                     ## move comp and timepoint to var
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                                   var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaslineFC"),
                                   Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                                   variable = NULL) %>%
                     ## make wider
                     tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "FC") %>%
                     ## remove columns with only NA
                     dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))),
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  
  
  #### add in delta for delta vars
  dplyr::full_join(phen_long %>%
                     ### first collect levels vars & remove baseline
                     dplyr::filter(variable %in% deltaFC_vars_to_use & Time_Point != "Baseline") %>%
                     ### remove naive animals
                     dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
                     ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
                     dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,delta)) %>%
                     ## move comp and timepoint to var
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                                   var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaslineDelta"),
                                   Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                                   variable = NULL) %>%
                     ## make wider
                     tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "delta") %>%
                     ## remove columns with only NA
                     dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))),
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  
  
  ### add in group 
  dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                     ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                     dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                     dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                     ungroup(), 
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
  ### factorize group
  dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
    names(group_colors_to_use),
    unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
```

```{r AssocWithADCCEff, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=9}
        ## filter to only the common animals
        rownames_to_column() %>%
        dplyr::filter(rowname %in% intersect(unique(rowname),rownames(curr_df1))) %>%
        column_to_rownames() %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      
      sp <- psych::corr.test(as.matrix(signif(curr_df1,7)), as.matrix(signif(curr_df2,7)), method = cor_method,
                             use="pairwise",
                             adjust="none",ci=FALSE)
      
      cor_mat <- sp$r
      cor_test_mat <- data.frame(sp$p)
      
      ## no adj p for multiple comparisons by BH over assays since never symmetric
      # cor_test_adj_mat <- cor_test_mat #duplicate dataframe to replace values
      # for(curr_assay in colnames(curr_df1)) {
      #   cor_test_adj_mat[curr_assay,] <- p.adjust(cor_test_mat[curr_assay,], method = "BH")
      # }
      # 
      #  
      #### also combine to dataframe since only one columns
      corr_df <- dplyr::left_join(data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "R_value"),
                                  data.frame(cor_test_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "raw_p"),
                                  by = c("var1","var2")) %>%
        ### add columns
        dplyr::mutate(
          ### set R_value to NA if p is NA i.e there were only 2 datapoints, some how the R is calculated but the p is not
          R_value = ifelse(is.na(raw_p),NA,R_value),
          
          #### for p < ann_pval_level
          dir = ifelse(R_value > 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                       "up", 
                       ifelse(R_value < 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                              "down","not_sig")),
          Group = paste0(curr_group))# %>%
      #### remove self correlations ---> none since comparing to olink
      #  dplyr::filter(var1 != var2)
      
      
      corr_df_combo <- rbind(corr_df_combo, corr_df)
      
    }
    
    # ### if FC or delta, remove baselines
    # if(curr_ds != "amount"){
    #   corr_df_combo <- corr_df_combo %>% 
    #     dplyr::filter(Time != "Baseline")
    # }
    # 
    ### save stats
    list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",Corr_name_base,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_",
                          substring(curr_ds,1,2) ## trim to 2 letters since too long for excel tab name
    )]] <- corr_df_combo
    
    # saveRDS(corr_df_combo, file = file.path(outputRData_dir, 
    #                                                               paste0(Corr_name,"_", cor_method,"_CoefPvals_untrimmed.rds")))
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    ################## now plot sig correlations for all groups
    
    
    
    
    cor_test_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,raw_p,Group) %>%
      ## replace NaN with na
      dplyr::mutate(raw_p = ifelse(is.nan(raw_p),NA,raw_p)) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "raw_p") %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      ## filter to only vars that are sig in at least one group
      dplyr::filter_at(vars(everything(.)), any_vars(. < ann_pval_level)) %>%
      as.matrix() 
    
    cor_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,R_value,Group) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "R_value") %>%
      ### filter to only sig vars
      dplyr::filter(var1 %in% rownames(cor_test_mat_for_plot)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    cl_ratio <- 0.2
    # pch_cex <- .6
    # tl_cex <- 0.1
    alluvial_text <- 3
    
    if(length(which(cor_test_mat_for_plot <  as.numeric(ann_pval_level))) == 0){
      
      
      cat(" ",paste0("no variables with p < ",ann_pval_level),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      
    }else{
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("corrplot"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      #### otherwise can use the stars
      corrplot::corrplot(cor_mat_for_plot, method = 'square', 
                         is.corr = FALSE, #since not symmetric
                         p.mat = cor_test_mat_for_plot,
                         sig.level = as.numeric(ann_pval_level), 
                         insig='label_sig',  #set p < 0.05 to blank
                         pch.cex = pch_cex, pch.col = 'white',tl.col = 'black',tl.cex=tl_cex,
                         ##legend
                         cl.ratio = cl_ratio, #cl.cex = 2,
                         #addCoef.col ='grey80', 
                         #number.cex = 0.5, #add corr coeff to sig circles
                         #order = order, ## CANNOT ORDER ASSYMMETRIC
                         col = (COL2('PuOr',1000)), ##make orange NEGATIVE
                         col.lim = c(-1,1) ##set limits to be the same across plots
                         # title = vaccine_groups[i], mar=c(0,0,1,0) # http://stackoverflow.com/a/14754408/54964
      )
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      ########## add alluvials
      
      
      
      df_for_alluvials <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        
        #        ### also remove inverse duplicates
        #        group_by(grp = paste(pmax(var1, var2), pmin(var1, var2), sep = "_")) %>%
        # dplyr::filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
        # ungroup() %>%
        # dplyr::select(-grp) %>%
        dplyr::select(-c(raw_p,R_value,var1,var2))  %>%
        
        ### remove notsig for all groups
        ## make wider
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = "dir") %>%
        column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
        ## remove rows if all not_sig 
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(. != "not_sig")) %>%
        ## also remove if all na
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
        ### back to long
        rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Group", values_to = "dir") %>%
        ## factorize
        dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, names(group_colors_to_use)),
                      dir = factor(dir, c("pos","not_sig","neg")),
                      variable = factor(variable)) %>%
        ## arrange
        dplyr::arrange(dir, variable, Group)
      
      
      color_df <- data.frame("group"=unique(levels(df_for_alluvials$dir)),
                             "color"=c("purple","grey","orange"),
                             "outline"=c("black","black","black"))
      
      curr_color_df <- color_df[which(color_df$group %in% unique(df_for_alluvials$dir)),]
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("alluvial"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      gg <- ggplot(df_for_alluvials,
                   aes(x = Group, stratum = dir, alluvium = variable))+
        stat_alluvium(aes(fill = dir), width = 1/2, alpha = 1/2,) +
        stat_stratum(aes(stratum = dir, fill = dir), width = 1/2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = curr_color_df$color)+
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) + ## to label NA category
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable, color = dir), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) +
        
        scale_color_manual(values = curr_color_df$outline)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(fill = paste0(cor_method," p < ", ann_pval_level, " R direction"))
      
      plot(gg)
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("table"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      
      to_print <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      var1_time = str_after_last(var1,"__"),
                      var1 = str_before_last(var1,"__"),
                      var2_time = str_after_last(var2,"__"),
                      var2 = str_before_last(var2,"__"),
                      
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        #### trim to variables in alluvial
        dplyr::filter(variable %in% df_for_alluvials$variable) %>%
        dplyr::select(-variable) %>%
        ## make wider to put the groups on the same line
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = c("raw_p","R_value","dir")) %>%
        DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                     buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                     iDisplayLength = 25,
                                     lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                       c(10,25,50,"All"))))
      
      #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
      print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
    }
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
  }else{
    cat(" ",paste0("no variables with same animals"),"\n")
    cat('\n')
    
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
}


```

```{r whichVarsTab, results='asis'}
var_types_list <- list("SuppFig4A_AvidityAbADCCEff"=c(list_of_vars[["ADCC_columns"]],list_of_vars[["eff_columns"]],list_of_vars[["Abs_columns"]]),
                       
                       "SuppFig4B_RectMucosaCells"=c(list_of_vars[["arifnew_NK"]],list_of_vars[["arifnew_mono"]],list_of_vars[["arifnew_DC"]]),
                       "SuppFig4C_PBMCcells"=c(list_of_vars[["massinew_mono"]],list_of_vars[["massinew_tcells"]]),
                       "SuppFig4D_CytoChemokines"=c(list_of_vars[["olink_columns"]])
                       
                       )




### for each type of variable
for(curr_vt in names(var_types_list)){
  
  curr_summ <- phen_long %>%
    ###remove unneeded metadata,FC and delta etc.
    dplyr::select(studyLetterForMS,Animal_comp_time,variable, amount) %>%
    ### trim to only these vars
    dplyr::filter(variable %in% var_types_list[[curr_vt]]) %>%
    ### summarize how many datapoints we have that are not NA
    dplyr::group_by(studyLetterForMS, variable) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(non_na_count = sum(!is.na(amount))) %>%
    ### make wide
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "studyLetterForMS", values_from = "non_na_count")
  
  ### now generate df to have all the studies
  df_to_plot <- data.frame(variable = curr_summ$variable)
  
  ### now add in the columns from curr_sum
  for(curr_study in levels(phen_long$studyLetterForMS)[1:7]){
    
    if(length(which(grepl(curr_study,colnames(curr_summ)) == TRUE) == 1)){
      ### if has data, add the column from curr_summ
          df_to_plot <- df_to_plot %>%
      dplyr::left_join(curr_summ[,c("variable",curr_study)], by = "variable")
    }else{
      ### if not add all NAs
      df_to_plot <- df_to_plot %>%
        ### add column with all NA
        dplyr::left_join(data.frame(variable = curr_summ$variable,
                           new_study = rep(NA, length(curr_summ$variable))) %>%
                           `colnames<-`(c("variable",curr_study)),
                         by = "variable")
        
    }
    
    

  }
  
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_vt),"\n")
cat("\n")


  ##### now swap in the study color if not na for plot
  df_to_plot2 <- df_to_plot %>%
    ### remove rows with only one study
    dplyr::filter_at(vars(studyA1:studyF), any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
    ## collect number of studies
    column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(numStudies = rowSums(!is.na(.)),
                  whichStudies = ifelse(!is.na(studyF),"first","next")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    ### make longer
    tidyr::pivot_longer(!c(variable,numStudies,whichStudies), names_to = "study", values_to = "value") %>%
    ## add color for non na values
    dplyr::mutate(study_have = ifelse(is.na(value),NA,study)) %>%
    ### remove unneeded columns
    dplyr::select(-value) %>%
    ## factorize to get order we want
    dplyr::mutate(study = factor(study, levels(phen_long$studyLetterForMS)[1:7])) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(whichStudies),numStudies,study, variable) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = factor(variable, unique(variable)),
                  numStudies = NULL) 
  
  p <- df_to_plot2 %>% 
    ggplot( aes(x = study, y = variable, fill = study_have))+
    geom_tile(color = "black")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = study_color_vec)+
    ## no buffer out side plot
    scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0))+
    scale_y_discrete(expand=c(0,0))+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position="none")
  
  plot(p)
  
   
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  list_of_plotted[[paste0(curr_vt)]] <- df_to_plot2

     cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
 
}

 
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!



```

```{r diffGroupsSummary, results='asis', fig.width=15, fig.height=12}
### only for amounts
curr_ds <- "amount"

#### collect df with values, long format
full_df <- curr_phen_long %>%
  ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
  dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use),variable,!!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
  ## move comp to var
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                var_comp = str_before_last(var_comp_time,"__"),
                Time_point = str_after_last(var_comp_time,"__"),
                Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                var_comp_time = NULL,
                variable = NULL) %>%
  
  ### factorize group & timepoint
  dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), intersect(
    names(group_colors_to_use),
    unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use]))),
    Time_point = factor(Time_point),
    ### add group_time
    group_time = paste0(Group_f,"__",Time_point)) %>%
  ### make longer
  ### arrange by ID
  dplyr::arrange(Sample_ID) %>%
  data.frame()


### recover stats - wilcox paired nad unpaired for amount
stats_data_df <-  list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_diff_",curr_ds)]] 


for(i in 1:nrow(stats_data_df)){
  stats_data_df[i,"est"] <- hl(full_df[which(full_df$group_time == stats_data_df$group2[i] &
                                               full_df$var_comp == stats_data_df$var_name[i]),"amount"], 
                               full_df[which(full_df$group_time == stats_data_df$group1[i] &
                                               full_df$var_comp == stats_data_df$var_name[i]),"amount"])
}

##### also get delta and Fc
delta_stats_df <-  list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_diff_delta")]] %>%
  ### remove Baseline
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Baseline",variable_comp_time)) %>%
  ### separate var from time
  dplyr::mutate(Comp = paste0("ALVACvsDNA__",str_after_last(variable_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaseline_delta"), ### comparison
                var_name = str_before_last(variable_comp_time,"__"),
                variable_comp_time = NULL) %>%
  dplyr::select(var_name,Comp,!!rlang::sym(colnames(.)[grepl("dir",colnames(.))])) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dir=3)


FC_stats_df <-  list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_diff_FC")]] %>%
  ### remove Baseline
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Baseline",variable_comp_time)) %>%
  ### separate var from time
  dplyr::mutate(Comp = paste0("ALVACvsDNA__",str_after_last(variable_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaseline_FC"), ### comparison
                var_name = str_before_last(variable_comp_time,"__"),
                variable_comp_time = NULL) %>%
  dplyr::select(var_name,Comp,!!rlang::sym(colnames(.)[grepl("dir",colnames(.))])) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dir=3)




######### set annotation for rows
annotation_row <- stats_data_df %>%
  ### add dir
  dplyr::mutate(dir = factor(ifelse(p < 0.05, ifelse(est > 0, "up, p < 0.05","down, p < 0.05"),
                                    ifelse(p < 0.1, ifelse(est > 0, "up, p < 0.1","down, p < 0.1"),
                                           ifelse(p>0.05,"not_sig","no_test"))),
                             c("up, p < 0.05","up, p < 0.1","not_sig","down, p < 0.1","down, p < 0.05","no_test")),
                ##make clearer names
                curr_var_set_name = paste0(curr_var_set),
                Comp = ifelse(Comp %in% c("DNA","ALVAC"),
                              ### for olink need to add timepoints
                              ifelse(curr_var_set_name == "olink_columns",
                                     paste0(Comp,"__",str_after_first(group2,"__"),"vs",str_after_first(group1,"__")),
                                     paste0(Comp,"__vsBaseline")),
                              paste0("ALVACvsDNA__",Comp))) %>%
  ### trim to only columns need
  dplyr::select(Comp,dir,var_name) %>%
  #### add delta and FC
  rbind(delta_stats_df[,c("Comp","dir","var_name")]) %>%
  rbind(FC_stats_df[,c("Comp","dir","var_name")]) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(curr_var_set_name = paste0(curr_var_set),
                ### set order
                Comp_order = ifelse(curr_var_set_name == "olink_columns",
                                    #### for olink columns
                                    ifelse(grepl("ALVAC__",Comp),
                                           ifelse(grepl("wk13vswk",Comp),
                                                  1,
                                                  ifelse(grepl("wk13vsB",Comp),
                                                         2,
                                                         3)),
                                           ifelse(startsWith(Comp,"DNA__"),
                                                  ifelse(grepl("wk13vswk",Comp),
                                                         4,
                                                         ifelse(grepl("wk13vsB",Comp),
                                                                5,
                                                                6)),
                                                  ifelse(grepl("__Baseline",Comp),
                                                         13,
                                                         ifelse(grepl("delta",Comp),
                                                                ifelse(grepl("wk13",Comp),
                                                                       7,
                                                                       8),
                                                                ifelse(grepl("FC",Comp),
                                                                       ifelse(grepl("wk13",Comp),
                                                                              9,
                                                                              10),
                                                                       ifelse(grepl("wk13",Comp),
                                                                              11,
                                                                              12)))))),
                                    
                                    
                                    
                                    #### for other single post baseline timepoint datasets
                                    
                                    ifelse(grepl("__Baseline",Comp),
                                           6,
                                           ifelse(grepl("delta",Comp),
                                                  3,
                                                  ifelse(grepl("FC",Comp),
                                                         4,
                                                         ifelse(grepl("DNA__vsBase",Comp),
                                                                2,
                                                                ifelse(grepl("ALVAC__vsBase",Comp),
                                                                       1,
                                                                       5)))))),
                
                rowname = var_name,
                curr_var_set_name = NULL) %>%

for(hmo in names(hm_orders_to_use)){
  
  ### make sorted by dir active
  if(hmo == "by dir, Assay"){
    tag_line <- " {.active}"
  }else{
    tag_line <- " "
  }
  
  cat("#### ", paste0("untrimmed, ",hmo,tag_line),"\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  
  
  ### arrange rows by order to use
  curr_ann_row1 <- dplyr::arrange(annotation_row,  annotation_row[,hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]]]) 
  
  
  
  tmp2 <-  df_to_plot[rownames(curr_ann_row1),intersect(rownames(annotation_col),colnames(df_to_plot))] %>%
    ### remove columns with all NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(.) any(!is.na(.))))
  
  ### set the gaps for the rows from first element of orders, except if assay
  if(hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]][1] != "Assay"){
    gaps_df <- data.frame(table(curr_ann_row1[,hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]][1]])) %>%
      mutate(cumsum = cumsum(Freq))
    if(length(unique(gaps_df$Freq)) ==1){
      if(unique(gaps_df$Freq) == 1){
        gaps_row_to_use <- 0
      }else{
        gaps_row_to_use <- unique(gaps_df$cumsum)
      }
      
    }else{
      gaps_row_to_use <- unique(gaps_df$cumsum)
    }
    
  }else{
    #gaps_df <- data.frame("cumsum"=c(0))
    gaps_row_to_use <- 0
  }
  
  #### gaps for column timepoints
  
  gaps_dfcol_prep <- annotation_col %>%
    ### add group time
    dplyr::mutate(group_time = paste0(Group_f,"__",Time_point),
                  group_time = factor(group_time, unique(group_time)))
  
  gaps_dfcol <- data.frame(table(gaps_dfcol_prep$group_time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Var1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cumsum = cumsum(Freq))     
  
  
  
  
  ### remove variable so not plotted
  curr_ann_row <- curr_ann_row1%>%
    dplyr::select(-var_name)

    row_font_size <- 3
  }else{
    row_font_size <- 7
  }
  
  
  
  hc <-
    pheatmap(tmp2,
             scale=row_scale_set, 
             na_col = "grey70",
             cluster_cols=FALSE, 
             cluster_rows = FALSE,
             fontsize_row = row_font_size,
             fontsize_col = 3,
             gaps_col =unique(gaps_dfcol$cumsum),
             gaps_row = gaps_row_to_use,
             col=mycols, breaks=breakscale, 
             clustering_method="ward.D2",
             annotation_col = annotation_col, 
             annotation_row = curr_ann_row,
             annotation_colors = annotation_colors)
  
  hc
  
  
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
}
```

```{r AssocWithOlink, results='asis', fig.height=12, fig.width=15}
### for each dataset type

for(curr_ds in ds_to_use){
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_ds," {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat('\n')
  
  
  Corr_name <- paste0(Corr_name_base,"_",curr_var_set,"_",curr_ds)
  
  ## full_df only has the variables in columns and the factorized group (plus any other covariates if they are in the model)
  
  full_df <- curr_phen_long %>%
    ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
    dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable, !!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
    ## move comp and timepoint to var
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                  var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                  Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                  variable = NULL) %>%
    ## make wider
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = all_of(curr_ds)) %>%
    ## remove columns with only NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
    ### add in group 
    dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                       dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                       ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                       dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                       dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                       ungroup(), 
                     by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
    ### factorize group
    dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
      names(group_colors_to_use),
      unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
  
  
  
  
  #### collect olink
  full_df_olink <- curr_phen_long_olink %>%
    ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
    dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable, !!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
    ## move comp and timepoint to var
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                  var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                  Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                  variable = NULL) %>%
    ## make wider
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = all_of(curr_ds)) %>%
    ## remove columns with only NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
    ### add in group 
    dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                       dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                       ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                       dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                       dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                       ungroup(), 
                     by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
    ### factorize group
    dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
      names(group_colors_to_use),
      unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
  
  
  
  
  #### need there to be some variables
  if(dim(full_df)[2] > 1){
    
    ### for each group separately
    ### prep to collect
    corr_df_combo <- data.frame()
    
    for(curr_group in names(group_colors_to_use)){
      
      
      #curr_df1: rows = samples, columns = variables
      #curr_df2: rows = samples, columns = olink
      
      
      curr_df1 <- full_df %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## filter to only the common animals
        rownames_to_column() %>%
        dplyr::filter(rowname %in% intersect(unique(rowname),rownames(full_df_olink))) %>%
        column_to_rownames() %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      curr_df2 <- full_df_olink %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## filter to only the common animals
        rownames_to_column() %>%
        dplyr::filter(rowname %in% intersect(unique(rowname),rownames(curr_df1))) %>%
        column_to_rownames() %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      
      ########## do correlation with psych package since much faster
      sp <- psych::corr.test(as.matrix(signif(curr_df1,7)), as.matrix(signif(curr_df2,7)), method = cor_method,
                             use="pairwise",
                             adjust="none",ci=FALSE)
      
      cor_mat <- sp$r
      cor_test_mat <- data.frame(sp$p)
      
      ## no adj p for multiple comparisons by BH over assays since never symmetric
      # cor_test_adj_mat <- cor_test_mat #duplicate dataframe to replace values
      # for(curr_assay in colnames(curr_df1)) {
      #   cor_test_adj_mat[curr_assay,] <- p.adjust(cor_test_mat[curr_assay,], method = "BH")
      # }
      # 
      #  
      #### also combine to dataframe since only one columns
      corr_df <- dplyr::left_join(data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "R_value"),
                                  data.frame(cor_test_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "raw_p"),
                                  by = c("var1","var2")) %>%
        ### add columns
        dplyr::mutate(
          ### set R_value to NA if p is NA i.e there were only 2 datapoints, some how the R is calculated but the p is not
          R_value = ifelse(is.na(raw_p),NA,R_value),
          
          #### for p < ann_pval_level
          dir = ifelse(R_value > 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                       "up", 
                       ifelse(R_value < 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                              "down","not_sig")),
          Group = paste0(curr_group))# %>%
      #### remove self correlations ---> none since comparing to olink
      #  dplyr::filter(var1 != var2)
      
      
      corr_df_combo <- rbind(corr_df_combo, corr_df)
      
    }
    
    # ### if FC or delta, remove baselines
    # if(curr_ds != "amount"){
    #   corr_df_combo <- corr_df_combo %>% 
    #     dplyr::filter(Time != "Baseline")
    # }
    # 
    ### save stats
    list_of_stats[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",Corr_name_base,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_",
                          substring(curr_ds,1,2) ## trim to 2 letters since too long for excel tab name
    )]] <- corr_df_combo
    
    # saveRDS(corr_df_combo, file = file.path(outputRData_dir, 
    #                                                               paste0(Corr_name,"_", cor_method,"_CoefPvals_untrimmed.rds")))
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    ################## now plot sig correlations for all groups
    
    
    
    
    cor_test_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,raw_p,Group) %>%
      ## replace NaN with na
      dplyr::mutate(raw_p = ifelse(is.nan(raw_p),NA,raw_p)) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "raw_p") %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      ## filter to only vars that are sig in at least one group
      dplyr::filter_at(vars(everything(.)), any_vars(. < ann_pval_level)) %>%
      as.matrix() 
    
    cor_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,R_value,Group) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "R_value") %>%
      ### filter to only sig vars
      dplyr::filter(var1 %in% rownames(cor_test_mat_for_plot)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    cl_ratio <- 0.2
    pch_cex <- .6
    tl_cex <- 0.1
    alluvial_text <- 3
    
    if(length(which(cor_test_mat_for_plot <  as.numeric(ann_pval_level))) == 0){
      
      
      cat(" ",paste0("no variables with p < ",ann_pval_level),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      
    }else{
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("corrplot"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      #### otherwise can use the stars
      corrplot::corrplot(cor_mat_for_plot, method = 'square', 
                         is.corr = FALSE, #since not symmetric
                         p.mat = cor_test_mat_for_plot,
                         sig.level = as.numeric(ann_pval_level), 
                         insig='label_sig',  #set p < 0.05 to blank
                         pch.cex = pch_cex, pch.col = 'white',tl.col = 'black',tl.cex=tl_cex,
                         ##legend
                         cl.ratio = cl_ratio, #cl.cex = 2,
                         #addCoef.col ='grey80', 
                         #number.cex = 0.5, #add corr coeff to sig circles
                         #order = order, ## CANNOT ORDER ASSYMMETRIC
                         col = (COL2('PuOr',1000)), ##make orange NEGATIVE
                         col.lim = c(-1,1) ##set limits to be the same across plots
                         # title = vaccine_groups[i], mar=c(0,0,1,0) # http://stackoverflow.com/a/14754408/54964
      )
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      ########## add alluvials
      
      
      
      df_for_alluvials <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        
        
        
        dplyr::select(-c(var1,var2,raw_p,R_value))  %>%
        
        ### remove notsig for all groups
        ## make wider
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = "dir") %>%
        column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
        ## remove rows if all not_sig 
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(. != "not_sig")) %>%
        ## also remove if all na
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
        ### back to long
        rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Group", values_to = "dir") %>%
        ## factorize
        dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, names(group_colors_to_use)),
                      dir = factor(dir, c("pos","not_sig","neg")),
                      variable = factor(variable)) %>%
        ## arrange
        dplyr::arrange(dir, variable, Group)
      
      
      color_df <- data.frame("group"=unique(levels(df_for_alluvials$dir)),
                             "color"=c("purple","grey","orange"),
                             "outline"=c("black","black","black"))
      
      curr_color_df <- color_df[which(color_df$group %in% unique(df_for_alluvials$dir)),]
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("alluvial"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      gg <- ggplot(df_for_alluvials,
                   aes(x = Group, stratum = dir, alluvium = variable))+
        stat_alluvium(aes(fill = dir), width = 1/2, alpha = 1/2,) +
        stat_stratum(aes(stratum = dir, fill = dir), width = 1/2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = curr_color_df$color)+
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) + ## to label NA category
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable, color = dir), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) +
        
        scale_color_manual(values = curr_color_df$outline)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(fill = paste0(cor_method," p < ", ann_pval_level, " R direction"))
      
      plot(gg)
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("table"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      
      to_print <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      var1_time = str_after_last(var1,"__"),
                      var1 = str_before_last(var1,"__"),
                      var2_time = str_after_last(var2,"__"),
                      var2 = str_before_last(var2,"__"),
                      
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        #### trim to variables in alluvial
        dplyr::filter(variable %in% df_for_alluvials$variable) %>%
        dplyr::select(-variable) %>%
        ## make wider to put the groups on the same line
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = c("raw_p","R_value","dir")) %>%
        DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                     buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                     iDisplayLength = 25,
                                     lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                       c(10,25,50,"All"))))
      
      #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
      print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
    }
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
  }else{
    cat(" ",paste0("no variables with same animals"),"\n")
    cat('\n')
    
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
}

```
