```{r heatmapSummary, results='asis', fig.height=25, fig.width=17}
## ---- NEW: category lookup keyed by row_lab, for use inside complete_grid ----
row_lab_category_lookup <- res %>%
  dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category)

complete_grid <- function(cols, dat) {
  tidyr::crossing(row_lab = row_levels, cols) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::select(dat, row_lab, strat_var, col_lab, eff_std, stars, int_sig, untestable),
      by = c("row_lab", "strat_var", "col_lab")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(row_lab_category_lookup, by = "row_lab") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      row_lab = factor(row_lab, levels = row_levels),
      col_lab = factor(col_lab, levels = unique(cols$col_lab)),
      panel   = factor(strat_var, levels = panel_levels),
      stars   = dplyr::coalesce(stars, ""),
      int_sig = dplyr::coalesce(int_sig, FALSE),
      ## NEW: untestable is a property of (category, strat_var), not of
      ## whether this particular row/col combo got a fitted model -- so
      ## re-derive it here from category_covariate_untestable directly,
      ## rather than relying on the join above (which would leave NA for
      ## any row/col combo that was never in `dat`, i.e. every grey tile)
      analyte = str_before_first(as.character(row_lab)," "),
      timepoint = str_after_last(as.character(row_lab)," "),
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, c("Baseline","Post","Delta","FC"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(category_covariate_untestable, by = c("category", "strat_var"), suffix = c("", "_lookup")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(untestable = dplyr::coalesce(untestable_lookup, FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-untestable_lookup)
}


cat_plot  <- complete_grid(cat_cols,  cat_res) 
cont_plot <- complete_grid(cont_cols, cont_res)

## FIX: complete_grid()'s final left_join (onto category_covariate_untestable,
## whose `category` column is plain character, never factored) silently
## drops the factor levels/ordering that were set on `category` earlier
## (category = factor(category, levels = c(category_levels_full, "(uncategorized)"))).
## dplyr::left_join() with mismatched column types (factor vs character) on
## either side of the key returns the join result as character, not factor --
## so by the time cat_plot/cont_plot are built, category has reverted to a
## plain character vector. The "sort by category" block's
## dplyr::arrange(category, analyte, timepoint) then sorts alphabetically
## instead of by category_display_order, since arrange() on a character
## column has no level order to respect.
## Re-assert the intended factor levels here, right after complete_grid(),
## so every downstream use of `category` (sorting, faceting, etc.) sees the
## correct order again.
cat_plot <- cat_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = factor(as.character(category), levels = c(category_levels_full, "(uncategorized)")))
cont_plot <- cont_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = factor(as.character(category), levels = c(category_levels_full, "(uncategorized)")))

lim_cat  <- max(abs(cat_plot$eff_std),  na.rm = TRUE)
lim_cont <- max(abs(cont_plot$eff_std), na.rm = TRUE)


## ---- 3. plot ---------------------------------------------------------
## ---- new: timepoint color mapping ----
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline" = "#FFFFB2",
  "Post"     = "#D9D95C",
  "Delta"    = "#A6A600",
  "FC"       = "#4D4D00"
)

## NEW: "category" added as a third sort option alongside "timepoint"
## and "analyte". Sorting by category groups all analytes in the same
## category together (in whatever order dplyr::arrange gives factors/
## strings -- alphabetical for character columns), and WITHIN each
## category, analytes are ordered alphabetically. This uses THREE sort
## keys (category, then analyte, then timepoint) rather than the usual
## two, so the row-building logic below needs a small generalization:
## the "other_col" logic that drives the spacer-insertion (blank rows
## between groups) is based on comparing consecutive rows' value in
## the PRIMARY sort column only. For "category", we still want spacers
## whenever the primary grouping value (category) changes, so this
## reuses the exact same spacer mechanism, just keyed off category
## instead of timepoint/analyte.

for(curr_sortcol in c("timepoint","analyte","category")){
  cat("#### ", "sort by ", curr_sortcol, " ", "\n\n")

  ## NEW: for "category", the secondary sort key is analyte
  ## (alphabetical within category); otherwise keep prior behavior
  ## (timepoint <-> analyte as each other's secondary key)
  if (curr_sortcol == "category") {
    other_col <- "analyte"
  } else {
    other_col <- setdiff(c("timepoint", "analyte"), curr_sortcol)
  }

  ## NEW: for "category", add a THIRD-level tiebreaker (timepoint) so
  ## that within the same category + same analyte, rows still land in
  ## a stable, sensible order (Baseline -> Post -> Delta -> FC) rather
  ## than whatever incidental order they appeared in upstream data.
  if (curr_sortcol == "category") {
    new_row_levels <- cat_plot %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::pull(row_lab) %>%
      rev()

    row_order_df <- cat_plot %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))

    stopifnot(identical(as.character(row_order_df$row_lab), as.character(new_row_levels)))

    ## the spacer/group-break logic below only needs ONE "sort_vals"
    ## vector to detect where a group boundary falls; use category
    ## here so a spacer line is drawn whenever the category changes
    sort_vals <- as.character(row_order_df[[curr_sortcol]])

  } else {
    new_row_levels <- cat_plot %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, timepoint, analyte) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(!!rlang::sym(curr_sortcol), !!rlang::sym(other_col)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(row_lab) %>%
      rev()

    row_order_df <- cat_plot %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, timepoint, analyte) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))

    stopifnot(identical(as.character(row_order_df$row_lab), as.character(new_row_levels)))  # sanity check

    sort_vals <- as.character(row_order_df[[curr_sortcol]])
  }

## ---- build a new level vector, inserting one spacer string after every group change ----
  ## Two boundary types now tracked:
  ##   - category_change: unchanged -- inserts a blank spacer ROW and
  ##     drives the existing THICK line (spacer_ypos)
  ##   - analyte_change (within the same category): NEW -- no spacer row
  ##     inserted (keeps heatmap height unchanged), just records a
  ##     half-integer y-position for a THIN line between the two analytes
  spacer_levels <- character(0)
  analyte_change_rowidx <- integer(0)
  n <- length(new_row_levels)

  ## per-row analyte vector, aligned to new_row_levels/sort_vals
  analyte_vals <- as.character(row_order_df[["analyte"]])

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, as.character(new_row_levels[i]))
    if (i < n && sort_vals[i] != sort_vals[i + 1]) {
      ## primary sort key (category) changed -> thick line + spacer row
      spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, paste0("__spacer__", i))
    } else if (i < n && analyte_vals[i] != analyte_vals[i + 1]) {
      ## analyte changed but category did NOT -> thin line only, no spacer row
      analyte_change_rowidx <- c(analyte_change_rowidx, length(spacer_levels))
    }
  }

  stopifnot(length(unique(spacer_levels)) == length(spacer_levels))  # no accidental dupes

  curr_cat_plot <- cat_plot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row_lab = factor(as.character(row_lab), levels = spacer_levels))
  curr_cont_plot <- cont_plot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row_lab = factor(as.character(row_lab), levels = spacer_levels))

  # blank labels for spacer rows only; keep everything else as-is
  y_labels <- ifelse(grepl("^__spacer__", spacer_levels), "", spacer_levels)

  # y-position (factor index) of each spacer row, for drawing a THICK line through the gap
  spacer_ypos <- which(grepl("^__spacer__", spacer_levels))

  # y-positions for THIN analyte-boundary lines, at the half-integer
  # boundary between the last row of one analyte and the first of the next
  analyte_spacer_ypos <- analyte_change_rowidx + 0.5

  ## ---- build row-metadata table for the sidebar, in plotted order ----
  row_meta <- data.frame(row_lab = spacer_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      dplyr::mutate(cat_plot,  row_lab = as.character(row_lab)),
      dplyr::mutate(cont_plot, row_lab = as.character(row_lab))
    ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, timepoint, analyte),
    by = "row_lab"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    row_lab   = factor(row_lab, levels = spacer_levels),
    is_spacer = grepl("^__spacer__", as.character(row_lab)),
    timepoint = factor(as.character(timepoint), levels = c("Baseline","Post","Delta","FC"))
  )

stopifnot(all(!is.na(row_meta$timepoint[!row_meta$is_spacer])))

  ## one label per analyte block: put text at the middle row of each contiguous block
  analyte_label_df <- row_meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(y = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(analyte) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(y_mid = mean(range(y)), .groups = "drop")

  max_label_width <- max(nchar(as.character(analyte_label_df$analyte)), na.rm = TRUE)

 ## ---- sidebar plot: color tile per row for timepoint + analyte text ----
sidebar <- ggplot(row_meta) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = "tile", y = row_lab, fill = timepoint),
            width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors, na.value = "white",
                     name = "Timepoint", drop = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = analyte_label_df,
            aes(x = "label", y = y_mid, label = analyte),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("label", "tile"),
                    expand = expansion(add = c(max_label_width * 0.17, 0.6))) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  ## NEW: thin line between analytes within the same category
  geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "left",
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

## build the untestable-cell slash segments for each panel, as a full
## diagonal across each flagged tile, ranked WITHIN each panel (not
## globally) so positions line up with facet_grid(scales="free_x")
  build_slash_segments <- function(df_panel) {
    df_panel %>%
      dplyr::filter(untestable) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, col_lab, panel) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(panel) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(x_num = dplyr::dense_rank(as.character(col_lab))) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y_num = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(x_num), !is.na(y_num)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        x    = x_num - 0.475, xend = x_num + 0.475,
        y    = y_num - 0.475, yend = y_num + 0.475
      )
  }

  slash_cat  <- build_slash_segments(curr_cat_plot)
  slash_cont <- build_slash_segments(curr_cont_plot)
  slash_all  <- dplyr::bind_rows(slash_cat, slash_cont)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = curr_cat_plot, aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, fill = eff_std, color = int_sig),
              linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +
    geom_text(data = curr_cat_plot, aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, label = stars),
              size = 8, vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim_cat, lim_cat), na.value = "grey90",
                         name = "Within-stratum\nALVAC - DNA\n(rank diff / n)") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(data = curr_cont_plot, aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, fill = eff_std, color = int_sig),
              linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +
    geom_text(data = curr_cont_plot, aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, label = stars),
              size = 8, vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1B7837", mid = "white", high = "darkorange",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim_cont, lim_cont), na.value = "grey90",
                         name = "Interaction slope\nper +1 SD\n(rank diff / n)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = NA), na.value = NA,
                       name = "Interaction\np < 0.05",
                       labels = c(`TRUE` = "yes", `FALSE` = "no")) +
    geom_segment(data = slash_all, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
    ## NEW: thin line between analytes within the same category
    geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(panel), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title = "Covariate effects on platform response: fingerprint by analyte",
         subtitle = paste0("Adjuvant/Sex: ALVAC vs DNA within stratum (red = ALVAC higher, blue = lower).  ",
                           "weight_c/ageChall_c: how the platform effect changes per +1 SD ",
                           "(orange = ALVAC advantage grows, green = shrinks).\n",
                           "* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001; black border = interaction p<0.05; ",
                           "grey = not tested; diagonal slash = untestable for this category (confounded or no data)")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

  combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(sidebar, p, ncol = 2, widths = c(1.4, 1))
  plot(combined)

  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n')
}
cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n')


```





### Supp Figure 13 (Interaction term NOT sig) {.tabset}


```{r indepConfoundedSummary, results='asis', fig.height=25, fig.width=17}

## ============================================================
## Summary panel for INDEPENDENT and CONFOUNDED analytes (those
## WITHOUT a significant covariate interaction worth stratifying).
##
## Unlike the MASKED/CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED "summary heatmap" (which
## shows per-STRATUM or per-SLOPE effects, because the whole point
## there is "the effect differs by covariate level"), these analytes
## have no such story -- the interesting thing to show is just:
##
##   1. the unadjusted ALVAC-vs-DNA effect (point)
##   2. how much that estimate MOVES across every covariate-adjustment
##      subset already fit in main_all (a min-max range/ribbon) --
##      this IS the operational definition of "confounded" here, so
##      drawing it directly makes the classification legible rather
##      than just asserting it in a column
##   3. whether the direction (sign) is consistent across all those
##      models (stable) or not (unstable/confounded)
##
## One row per analyte x dataset_type (not per stratum -- there's
## nothing to stratify by here). Rows grouped/colored by
## model_summary (INDEPENDENT vs CONFOUNDED), and within that,
## faceted by direction (up/no change/down) and sorted either by
## timepoint, analyte, or category.
##
## DIRECTION FACET LOGIC:
##   - "up"/"down": unadjusted is significant (use its sign), OR the
##     analyte is CONFOUNDED and unadjusted was NOT significant but
##     some ADJUSTED model found significance (use the sign of the
##     adjusted model with the smallest p-value). This means an
##     analyte that is non-significant unadjusted but becomes
##     significant somewhere under adjustment still shows up in
##     up/down (flagged distinctly -- see point shape below), rather
##     than hiding in "no change".
##   - "no change": reserved for analytes that are ROBUSTLY
##     non-significant -- unadjusted not sig, AND (either INDEPENDENT,
##     meaning no adjusted model found significance either, OR
##     CONFOUNDED but with no determinable adjusted-model direction).
##
## POINT ENCODING in the up/down facets (CONFOUNDED only; INDEPENDENT
## points are always a fixed solid circle, since by definition they're
## stable and don't need these extra flags):
##   - shape: circle = unadjusted itself was significant (normal case).
##            triangle = unadjusted was NOT significant; routed here
##            only because some adjusted model was significant.
##   - size: fraction of adjusted-subset models that were significant
##     (adj_pct_sig) -- bigger point = more adjusted models agree.
##
## Row-ordering / spacer-line mechanism below is copied directly from
## the proven heatmapSummary chunk: row_order_df is explicitly
## reordered via slice(match(new_row_levels, row_lab)) so it is
## guaranteed to be in the same (reversed/plotted) order as
## new_row_levels before sort_vals/analyte_vals are pulled from it.
## ============================================================

## ---- 1. pull rows classified as INDEPENDENT or CONFOUNDED --------
## (MASKED / CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED are handled by your existing
## stratified heatmapSummary chunk -- this chunk explicitly excludes them)

indep_conf_summary <- analyte_summary_long %>%
  dplyr::distinct(category, analyte, dataset_type, model_summary,
                  main_est_unadj, main_p_unadj, main_p_min, main_p_max,
                  n_adj_models, n_main_changed) %>%
  dplyr::filter(model_summary %in% c("INDEPENDENT", "CONFOUNDED"))

## de-dup defensively: indep_conf_summary should already be one row per
## analyte x dataset_type, but if any upstream join ever produces
## duplicates, they'd silently break the spacer-line bookkeeping below.
indep_conf_summary <- indep_conf_summary %>%
  dplyr::distinct(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary, .keep_all = TRUE)

## ---- 2. per-analyte x dataset_type: full range of estimates across
## every covariate-adjustment subset (Unadjusted -> full model),
## pulled directly from main_all (same source feeding
## summarize_main_stability() above) ----
estimate_range_df <- main_all %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    indep_conf_summary %>% dplyr::select(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary),
    by = c("analyte", "dataset_type")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    est_min  = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    est_max  = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    ## does the estimate's sign flip anywhere across the adjustment set?
    sign_flip = (min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) * max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)) < 0,
    n_models  = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## ---- 2b. per-analyte x dataset_type: diagnostics on the ADJUSTED
## models specifically (everything except "Unadjusted"), used to
## characterize CONFOUNDED points in the up/down facets:
##   - adj_pct_sig: fraction of adjusted-subset models with p<0.05
##   - adj_sign_at_pmin: sign of the estimate in whichever adjusted
##     model had the smallest p-value (used to pick a direction for
##     analytes that are CONFOUNDED but non-significant unadjusted)
## ----
adj_diag_df <- main_all %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    indep_conf_summary %>% dplyr::select(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary),
    by = c("analyte", "dataset_type")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adjustment != "Unadjusted") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    adj_pct_sig = mean(p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    adj_n       = dplyr::n(),
    .best_idx   = which.min(p.value),
    adj_sign_at_pmin = sign(estimate[.best_idx]),
    adj_p_at_pmin     = p.value[.best_idx],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.best_idx)


## ---- 2c. per-analyte x dataset_type: proportion of ALL models
## (unadjusted + every adjusted subset) that were significant.
## Used for point size now (previously this was adjusted-only). ----
all_model_diag_df <- main_all %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    indep_conf_summary %>% dplyr::select(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary),
    by = c("analyte", "dataset_type")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, dataset_type, model_summary) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_pct_sig = mean(p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_n       = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indep_conf_plot_df <- indep_conf_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(estimate_range_df, by = c("analyte", "dataset_type", "model_summary")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(adj_diag_df, by = c("analyte", "dataset_type", "model_summary")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_model_diag_df, by = c("analyte", "dataset_type", "model_summary")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    row_lab = paste(analyte, dataset_type, sep = " | "),
    stars   = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(main_p_unadj) ~ "",
      main_p_unadj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      main_p_unadj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      main_p_unadj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    timepoint = factor(dataset_type, levels = c("Baseline","Post","Delta","FC")),
    unadj_sig = !is.na(main_p_unadj) & main_p_unadj < 0.05,
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      unadj_sig & main_est_unadj > 0  ~ "up",
      unadj_sig & main_est_unadj < 0  ~ "down",
      !unadj_sig & model_summary == "CONFOUNDED" & !is.na(adj_sign_at_pmin) & adj_sign_at_pmin > 0 ~ "up",
      !unadj_sig & model_summary == "CONFOUNDED" & !is.na(adj_sign_at_pmin) & adj_sign_at_pmin < 0 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "no change"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, c("up", "no change", "down")),
    ## which route got an analyte into up/down: "unadjusted" (normal
    ## case) vs "adjusted-only" (CONFOUNDED, non-sig unadjusted, but
    ## routed here because some adjusted model was significant) --
    ## used to pick point shape below
    route = dplyr::case_when(
      direction != "no change" & unadj_sig  ~ "unadjusted",
      direction != "no change" & !unadj_sig ~ "adjusted-only",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

## keep the same explicit category order used in heatmapSummary, if present
if (exists("category_levels_full")) {
  indep_conf_plot_df <- indep_conf_plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(category = factor(as.character(category),
                                    levels = c(category_levels_full, "(uncategorized)")))
}



## ---- 3. scale: estimate is on the rank scale, same as elsewhere;
## std by n is NOT applied here (unlike the stratified heatmap) since
## there's no "per-group-size" subtlety -- we want the raw rank-sum
## shift and its stability, not a rate ----
lim_indep_conf <- max(abs(c(indep_conf_plot_df$est_min, indep_conf_plot_df$est_max,
                            indep_conf_plot_df$main_est_unadj)), na.rm = TRUE)

model_summary_colors <- c(INDEPENDENT = "purple3", CONFOUNDED = "goldenrod1")

timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline" = "#FFFFB2",
  "Post"     = "#D9D95C",
  "Delta"    = "#A6A600",
  "FC"       = "#4D4D00"
)

## ---- 4. render: one tab per sort option, one sub-tab per direction ----
for (curr_sortcol in c("timepoint", "analyte", "category")) {

  cat("#### ", "sort by ", curr_sortcol, " {.tabset} ", "\n\n")

  for (curr_dir in levels(indep_conf_plot_df$direction)) {

    cat("##### ", curr_dir, " \n\n")

    dir_df <- indep_conf_plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(direction == curr_dir)

    if (nrow(dir_df) == 0) {
      cat(" ", "no analytes in this category", "\n\n")
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n')
      next
    }

    ## ---- row order, built EXACTLY like heatmapSummary's proven
    ## pattern: compute new_row_levels first (already reversed, i.e.
    ## bottom-to-top plotted order), THEN reorder row_order_df to match
    ## via slice(match(...)) so sort_vals/analyte_vals pulled from it
    ## are guaranteed to be in that same plotted order. ----
    if (curr_sortcol == "category") {
      new_row_levels <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::pull(row_lab) %>%
        rev()

      row_order_df <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint, model_summary) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
        dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))

    } else if (curr_sortcol == "analyte") {
      new_row_levels <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(analyte, timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::pull(row_lab) %>%
        rev()

      row_order_df <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint, model_summary) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
        dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))

    } else {
      new_row_levels <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(timepoint, analyte) %>%
        dplyr::pull(row_lab) %>%
        rev()

      row_order_df <- dir_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(row_lab, category, analyte, timepoint, model_summary) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
        dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))
    }

    ## sanity check: row_order_df must now be in IDENTICAL order to
    ## new_row_levels, or every downstream position (spacer_ypos,
    ## analyte_spacer_ypos, sidebar tile y-positions) desyncs from what
    ## actually gets drawn.
    stopifnot(identical(as.character(row_order_df$row_lab), as.character(new_row_levels)))

    sort_vals    <- as.character(row_order_df[[curr_sortcol]])
    analyte_vals <- as.character(row_order_df[["analyte"]])

    ## ---- build a new level vector, inserting one blank spacer string
    ## after every group change (same mechanism as heatmapSummary):
    ##   - primary sort key changes -> insert a blank spacer ROW,
    ##     drives a THICK line (spacer_ypos)
    ##   - analyte changes but primary key doesn't -> no row inserted,
    ##     just record a half-integer y-position for a THIN line ----
    spacer_levels <- character(0)
    analyte_change_rowidx <- integer(0)
    n <- length(new_row_levels)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, as.character(new_row_levels[i]))
      if (i < n && sort_vals[i] != sort_vals[i + 1]) {
        spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, paste0("__spacer__", i))
      } else if (i < n && analyte_vals[i] != analyte_vals[i + 1]) {
        analyte_change_rowidx <- c(analyte_change_rowidx, length(spacer_levels))
      }
    }

    stopifnot(length(unique(spacer_levels)) == length(spacer_levels))

plot_df <- dir_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = factor(as.character(row_lab), levels = spacer_levels)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        point_size_val = dplyr::coalesce(total_pct_sig, 0),
        ## zero models significant gets an X marker instead of a filled
        ## circle, so there's still a visible point at the unadjusted
        ## estimate even when nothing was ever significant.
        point_shape = dplyr::if_else(point_size_val == 0, "none_sig", "has_sig"),
        ## outline/stroke color: black whenever unadjusted was
        ## significant OR the point is rendered as an X (since X glyphs
        ## use only `color`, not `fill` -- a transparent stroke on an X
        ## would make it invisible, defeating the point of the X marker)
        point_outline = dplyr::case_when(
          point_shape == "none_sig" ~ "black",
          unadj_sig                 ~ "black",
          TRUE                       ~ "transparent"
        )
      )

    stopifnot(all(plot_df$point_size_val[plot_df$point_shape == "has_sig"] > 0))

    spacer_ypos <- which(grepl("^__spacer__", spacer_levels))
    analyte_spacer_ypos <- analyte_change_rowidx + 0.5

    ## ---- row-metadata table for the sidebar, in plotted order ----
    row_meta <- data.frame(row_lab = spacer_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        dplyr::distinct(plot_df, row_lab = as.character(row_lab), timepoint, analyte, model_summary),
        by = "row_lab"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        row_lab   = factor(row_lab, levels = spacer_levels),
        is_spacer = grepl("^__spacer__", as.character(row_lab)),
        timepoint = factor(as.character(timepoint), levels = c("Baseline","Post","Delta","FC"))
      )

    stopifnot(all(!is.na(row_meta$timepoint[!row_meta$is_spacer])))

    ## one label per analyte block: text at the middle row of each
    ## contiguous block (identical approach to heatmapSummary)
    analyte_label_df <- row_meta %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(analyte) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(y_mid = mean(range(y)), .groups = "drop")

    max_label_width <- max(nchar(as.character(analyte_label_df$analyte)), na.rm = TRUE)

    sidebar <- ggplot(row_meta) +
      geom_tile(aes(x = "classification", y = row_lab, fill = model_summary),
                width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = model_summary_colors, na.value = "white",
                        name = "Classification", drop = FALSE) +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_tile(aes(x = "timepoint", y = row_lab, fill = timepoint),
                width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors, na.value = "white",
                        name = "Timepoint", drop = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = analyte_label_df,
                aes(x = "label", y = y_mid, label = analyte),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, size = 3) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = c("label", "classification", "timepoint"),
                        expand = expansion(add = c(max_label_width * 0.17, 0.6))) +
      scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      theme_void() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

    ## ---- main panel: range bar (min-max estimate across adjustment
    ## subsets) + point for the unadjusted estimate.
    ##
    ## Point encoding for CONFOUNDED analytes (INDEPENDENT points are
    ## always solid filled circles at a fixed size, since by definition
    ## they're stable and don't need these extra flags):
    ##   - shape: triangle = "adjusted-only" route (unadjusted was NOT
    ##     significant; this analyte only appears in up/down because
    ##     some adjusted model found significance). Circle = normal
    ##     route (unadjusted itself was significant).
    ##   - size: scaled by adj_pct_sig (fraction of adjusted models
    ##     that were significant) -- bigger point = more of the
    ##     adjusted models agree with the direction shown, smaller
    ##     point = only a minority of adjusted models were significant.
    ## ----

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = row_lab)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = est_min, xmax = est_max, color = model_summary,
                         linewidth = sign_flip),
                     height = 0.25) +
      scale_color_manual(values = model_summary_colors, name = "Classification") +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
      geom_point(aes(x = main_est_unadj, fill = model_summary,
                     color = point_outline, size = point_size_val,
                     shape = point_shape),
                 stroke = 1.1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = model_summary_colors, name = "Classification") +
      scale_color_identity(name = "Unadjusted\nsignificant",
                           breaks = c("black", "transparent"),
                           labels = c("yes", "no"),
                           guide = "legend") +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(has_sig = 21, none_sig = 4),
        name = "Any model\nsignificant",
        labels = c(has_sig = "yes", none_sig = "no (0%)")
      ) +
      scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.1, `FALSE` = 0.5),
                             name = "Sign flips\nacross models",
                             labels = c(`TRUE` = "yes", `FALSE` = "no")) +
      scale_radius(
        range = c(0, 5), limits = c(0, 1),
        name = "% of all models\n(unadj + adj)\nsignificant",
        breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
        guide = guide_legend(
          override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "black", color = "black")
        )
      ) +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-lim_indep_conf, lim_indep_conf)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
      labs(x = "Platform effect (rank scale)", y = NULL,
           title = paste0("Analytes without a significant covariate interaction \u2014 ", curr_dir),
           subtitle = paste0(
             "Point = unadjusted estimate; stars column at right (*p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001).\n",
             "Bar = range of the estimate across every covariate-adjustment subset tried.\n",
             "INDEPENDENT (purple) = range stays one sign and on the same side of the null as unadjusted.\n",
             "CONFOUNDED (gold) = estimate moves/flips sign across adjustment subsets.\n",
             "Black outline = unadjusted estimate itself was significant (p<0.05); no outline = unadjusted was not significant.\n",
             "Point size = proportion of ALL models (unadjusted + every adjusted subset) that were significant.\n",
             "\"no change\" facet = robustly non-significant: unadjusted not sig AND no adjusted model found significance either."
           )) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    ## ---- p-value stars column, to the right of the main panel ----
    p_stars <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = 1, y = row_lab)) +
      geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 5, hjust = 0.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 1.1), breaks = NULL) +
      scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "sig.", y = NULL) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        plot.margin  = margin(l = 2)
      )

    ## collect guides from all three sub-plots and place at the bottom,
    ## so the legend doesn't sit between the main panel and the stars
    ## column. Note: sidebar's own Classification/Timepoint tile legend
    ## and the main panel's Classification/Sign-flip/Shape/Size legends
    ## are all swept into this one collected legend -- Classification
    ## will appear twice (once as a tile swatch, once as a point/line
    ## swatch) since they're built from different geoms/scales; this is
    ## a cosmetic duplication, not a data issue.
    combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(sidebar, p, p_stars, ncol = 3, widths = c(1.4, 1, 0.15)) +
      patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
      ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

    print(combined)

    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n')
  }

  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n')
}

cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n')

```

```{r vsTOA_cov_setup}



## ============================================================
## vsTOA covariate-adjusted analysis
## ============================================================
## Parallel to the nonTOA Platform-vs-analyte pipeline, but here the
## OUTCOME is Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status) and the TERM OF INTEREST
## is rank(analyte) -- i.e. "does this analyte's relationship with TOA,
## WITHIN a given platform (DNA-only or DNA/ALVAC, studyF excluded),
## survive adjustment for Sex/Adjuvant/Weight/Age, and does any of
## those covariates modify (interact with) that relationship?"
## ============================================================

covariates_for_TOAcov <- weights_df_base %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, weight_at_first_challenge) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(age_df_base %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, age_at_first_challenge),
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = as.character(Sample_ID))

TOAcov_animal_base <- raw_df_TOA %>%
  dplyr::filter(studyLetterForMS != "studyF") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Platform  = factor(Group_ignoreALFQA, levels = c("Naive", "DNA", "ALVAC")),
    Sex       = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Adjuvant  = factor(str_before_first(str_after_first(Group, "_"), "_"), levels = c("Alum", "ALFQA")),
    Sample_ID = as.character(Sample_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Platform != "Naive") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Platform = droplevels(Platform)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Platform, Sex, Adjuvant, TOA_adj, Infection_status) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(covariates_for_TOAcov, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Platform) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    weight_c   = weight_at_first_challenge - mean(weight_at_first_challenge, na.rm = TRUE),
    ageChall_c = age_at_first_challenge   - mean(age_at_first_challenge,   na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

covariate_labels_TOAcov <- c(
  Sex        = "Sex",
  Adjuvant   = "Adjuvant",
  weight_c   = "Weight",
  ageChall_c = "Age at Challenge"
)
TOAcov_covariate_order <- c("Sex", "Adjuvant", "weight_c", "ageChall_c")
TOAcov_platform_labels <- c(DNA = "DNA-only", ALVAC = "DNA/ALVAC")
```

```{r vsTOA_cov_data_builder}

build_analyte_TOAcov_data <- function(analyte) {

  analyte_long <- phen_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(variable == analyte, !grepl("Naive", Group)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = as.character(Sample_ID))

  has_baseline <- any(analyte_long$Time_Point == "Baseline")
  post_tp <- analyte_long %>% dplyr::filter(Time_Point != "Baseline") %>% dplyr::pull(Time_Point) %>% unique()

  out <- list()
  if (length(post_tp) == 0) return(out)
  post_tp_use <- post_tp[1]

  post_df <- analyte_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(Time_Point == post_tp_use) %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample_ID, amount) %>%
    dplyr::rename(value = amount) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(TOAcov_animal_base, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
  if (nrow(post_df) > 0) out[["Post"]] <- post_df

  if (has_baseline) {

    baseline_df <- analyte_long %>%
      dplyr::filter(Time_Point == "Baseline") %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, amount) %>%
      dplyr::rename(baseline_amount = amount)

    base_out <- baseline_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(value = baseline_amount) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(TOAcov_animal_base, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
    if (nrow(base_out) > 0) out[["Baseline"]] <- base_out

    delta_fc_df <- analyte_long %>%
      dplyr::filter(Time_Point == post_tp_use) %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, amount) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(baseline_df, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_value = amount - baseline_amount,
        FC_value    = 100 * (amount / baseline_amount)
      )

    delta_out <- delta_fc_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(value = delta_value) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(TOAcov_animal_base, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
    if (nrow(delta_out) > 0) out[["Delta"]] <- delta_out

    fc_out <- delta_fc_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(value = FC_value) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(TOAcov_animal_base, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
    if (nrow(fc_out) > 0) out[["FC"]] <- fc_out
  }

  out
}
```

```{r vsTOA_testability_build}

## ============================================================
## PART 1 (build): testability table, one row per analyte x
## dataset_type x platform, with group-size (n_male/n_female/
## n_alum/n_alfqa) and event-count reporting.
## ============================================================

assess_TOAcov_testability_row <- function(df_platform) {

  n_total    <- nrow(df_platform)
  n_events   <- sum(df_platform$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_censored <- n_total - n_events

  sex_tab <- table(df_platform$Sex)
  sex_testable <- length(sex_tab[sex_tab > 0]) >= 2
  n_male   <- unname(sex_tab["Male"]);   if (is.na(n_male)) n_male <- 0
  n_female <- unname(sex_tab["Female"]); if (is.na(n_female)) n_female <- 0

  adj_tab <- table(df_platform$Adjuvant)
  adjuvant_testable <- length(adj_tab[adj_tab > 0]) >= 2
  n_alum  <- unname(adj_tab["Alum"]);  if (is.na(n_alum)) n_alum <- 0
  n_alfqa <- unname(adj_tab["ALFQA"]); if (is.na(n_alfqa)) n_alfqa <- 0

  weight_sd <- stats::sd(df_platform$weight_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  age_sd    <- stats::sd(df_platform$ageChall_c, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    n_animals         = n_total,
    n_events          = n_events,
    n_censored        = n_censored,
    n_male            = n_male,
    n_female          = n_female,
    n_alum            = n_alum,
    n_alfqa           = n_alfqa,
    Sex_testable      = sex_testable,
    n_sex_levels      = length(sex_tab[sex_tab > 0]),
    Adjuvant_testable = adjuvant_testable,
    n_adjuvant_levels = length(adj_tab[adj_tab > 0]),
    weight_sd         = weight_sd,
    age_sd            = age_sd,
    Weight_testable   = !is.na(weight_sd) & weight_sd > 1e-8,
    Age_testable      = !is.na(age_sd)    & age_sd    > 1e-8
  )
}

build_TOAcov_testability_table <- function(category_vars_list) {

  purrr::imap_dfr(category_vars_list, function(vars_vec, cat_name) {

    purrr::map_dfr(vars_vec, function(curr_analyte) {

      data_list <- build_analyte_TOAcov_data(curr_analyte)
      if (length(data_list) == 0) return(NULL)

      purrr::imap_dfr(data_list, function(df, ds_type) {

        purrr::map_dfr(levels(TOAcov_animal_base$Platform), function(plat) {

          df_p <- dplyr::filter(df, Platform == plat)
          if (nrow(df_p) == 0) return(NULL)

          assess_TOAcov_testability_row(df_p) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(category = cat_name, analyte = curr_analyte,
                          dataset_type = ds_type, platform = plat)
        })
      })
    })
  })
}

TOAcov_testability_table <- build_TOAcov_testability_table(nonTOA_category_vars)

get_TOAcov_covariate_set <- function(analyte, ds_type, plat) {

  row <- TOAcov_testability_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(analyte == !!analyte, dataset_type == !!ds_type, platform == !!plat)

  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(character(0))

  covs <- c(
    if (isTRUE(row$Sex_testable[1]))      "Sex",
    if (isTRUE(row$Adjuvant_testable[1])) "Adjuvant",
    if (isTRUE(row$Weight_testable[1]))   "weight_c",
    if (isTRUE(row$Age_testable[1]))      "ageChall_c"
  )
  intersect(TOAcov_covariate_order, covs)
}
```

```{r vsTOA_cov_unadjusted_spearman}

## ============================================================
## Systematic UNADJUSTED Spearman, analyte vs TOA_adj, within each
## platform, for EVERY analyte in nonTOA_category_vars (not a
## manuscript-text-based lookup). This defines "previously reported"
## programmatically: TRUE if this exact test would already have
## flagged the analyte as a TOA correlate.
##
## *** MATCHED EXACTLY TO THE EXISTING AssocWithTOA CHUNK: ***
## psych::corr.test(method="spearman", use="pairwise", adjust="none",
## ci=FALSE), with signif(x,7) pre-rounding on both inputs -- NOT
## base R stats::cor.test. cor_method is re-set to "spearman" here
## defensively since TOA_prep sets it earlier but this chunk may be
## knitted out of that exact order.
## ============================================================

cor_method <- "spearman"

compute_unadjusted_spearman_vsTOA <- function(category_vars_list) {

  purrr::imap_dfr(category_vars_list, function(vars_vec, cat_name) {

    purrr::map_dfr(vars_vec, function(curr_analyte) {

      data_list <- build_analyte_TOAcov_data(curr_analyte)
      if (length(data_list) == 0) return(NULL)

      purrr::imap_dfr(data_list, function(df, ds_type) {

        purrr::map_dfr(levels(TOAcov_animal_base$Platform), function(plat) {

          df_p <- dplyr::filter(df, Platform == plat, !is.na(value), !is.na(TOA_adj))
          if (nrow(df_p) < 4) return(NULL)

          ## identical call shape to AssocWithTOA: psych::corr.test on
          ## signif(.,7)-rounded matrices, method/use/adjust/ci matched
          sp <- tryCatch(
            psych::corr.test(
              as.matrix(signif(df_p$value, 7)),
              as.matrix(signif(df_p$TOA_adj, 7)),
              method = cor_method,
              use    = "pairwise",
              adjust = "none",
              ci     = FALSE
            ),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          if (is.null(sp)) return(NULL)

          data.frame(
            category = cat_name, analyte = curr_analyte, dataset_type = ds_type, platform = plat,
            spearman_R = unname(sp$r[1, 1]), spearman_p = unname(sp$p[1, 1]),
            n = nrow(df_p)
          )
        })
      })
    })
  })
}

TOA_unadjusted_spearman <- compute_unadjusted_spearman_vsTOA(nonTOA_category_vars)

list_of_stats[["vsTOAcov_unadjusted_spearman"]] <- TOA_unadjusted_spearman

previously_reported_lookup <- TOA_unadjusted_spearman %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, platform) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    previously_reported = any(spearman_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    previously_reported_dataset_types = paste(dataset_type[spearman_p < 0.05], collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

TOAcov_testability_table <- TOAcov_testability_table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(previously_reported_lookup, by = c("analyte", "platform")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    previously_reported = dplyr::coalesce(previously_reported, FALSE),
    previously_reported_dataset_types = dplyr::coalesce(previously_reported_dataset_types, "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    TOA_unadjusted_spearman %>% dplyr::select(analyte, dataset_type, platform, spearman_R, spearman_p),
    by = c("analyte", "dataset_type", "platform")
  )
```

```{r vsTOA_cov_model_functions}

## ============================================================
## PART 2: Main-effect and interaction panels for analyte-vs-TOA,
## within one platform. Structural copy of build_covariate_panel()/
## build_interaction_panel(), outcome = Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status),
## term of interest = analyte_rank.
## ============================================================

build_analyte_TOA_panel <- function(data, analyte_var,
                                     covariate_vars, covariate_labels,
                                     contrast_label,
                                     palette = c("gold", "darkorange", "magenta2", "purple4")) {

  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[analyte_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(analyte_rank = rank(.data[[analyte_var]], ties.method = "average"))

  if (nrow(data) < 5 || sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE) < 2) {
    return(list(rows = data.frame(), plot = NULL, n = nrow(data),
               n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  term_of_interest <- "analyte_rank"

  all_combo_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(0:length(covariate_vars), function(k) {

    combo_list <- if (k == 0) list(character(0)) else utils::combn(covariate_vars, k, simplify = FALSE)

    purrr::map_dfr(combo_list, function(covs) {

      rhs <- if (length(covs) == 0) "analyte_rank" else paste("analyte_rank", paste(covs, collapse = " + "), sep = " + ")

      fit <- tryCatch(
        survival::coxph(
          stats::as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status) ~ ", rhs)),
          data = data
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL,
        warning = function(w) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

      coef_row <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::filter(term == term_of_interest)
      if (nrow(coef_row) == 0) return(NULL)

      adjustment_label <- if (length(covs) == 0) "Unadjusted" else paste0("+ ", paste(covariate_labels[covs], collapse = " + "))

      dplyr::mutate(coef_row,
        adjustment   = adjustment_label,
        n_covariates = length(covs),
        covs_raw     = list(covs),
        n_used       = nrow(stats::model.frame(fit)),
        n_events     = sum(data$Infection_status[rownames(data) %in% rownames(stats::model.frame(fit))], na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    })
  })

  if (nrow(all_combo_rows) == 0) return(list(rows = data.frame(), plot = NULL, n = nrow(data),
                                             n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE)))

  all_combo_rows <- all_combo_rows %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sort_key = paste(as.integer(covariate_vars %in% covs_raw), collapse = "")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  panel_rows <- all_combo_rows %>%
    dplyr::arrange(n_covariates, dplyr::desc(sort_key)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      adjustment = factor(adjustment, rev(unique(adjustment))),
      row_id     = as.integer(adjustment),
      p_label    = dplyr::if_else(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p.value, digits = 3, format = "f")),
      sig        = p.value < 0.05
    )

  upset_long <- panel_rows %>%
    dplyr::select(adjustment, row_id, covs_raw) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(covariate = list(covariate_vars)) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(covariate) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_member = covariate %in% covs_raw) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(covariate_label = factor(covariate_labels[covariate], levels = covariate_labels[covariate_vars]))

  upset_segments <- upset_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_member) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(row_id, adjustment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(x_min = min(as.integer(covariate_label)), x_max = max(as.integer(covariate_label)), .groups = "drop")

  p_upset <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = upset_long, aes(x = covariate_label, y = adjustment), color = "grey85", size = 2.2) +
    geom_segment(data = upset_segments, aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, y = adjustment, yend = adjustment), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(upset_long, is_member), aes(x = covariate_label, y = adjustment), color = "grey20", size = 2.6) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93"), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 7, angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(r = 2))

  p_pvalue <- ggplot(panel_rows, aes(x = 1, y = adjustment)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = p_label), size = 3, hjust = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 1.1), breaks = NULL) +
    labs(x = "p-value", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(l = 2))

  n_total  <- nrow(data)
  n_events <- sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE)

  p_forest <- ggplot(panel_rows, aes(x = estimate, y = adjustment, color = factor(n_covariates))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.2) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "p < 0.05", values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "# covariates\nadjusted for",
                       values = grDevices::colorRampPalette(palette)(length(covariate_vars) + 1)) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
    labs(x = "HR per rank-unit of analyte (log scale)", y = NULL,
         title = paste0(contrast_label, ": analyte vs TOA across covariate-adjustment combinations"),
         subtitle = paste0(nrow(panel_rows), " models (all subsets of ",
                           paste(covariate_labels[covariate_vars], collapse = ", "),
                           "); full dataset n=", n_total, ", ", n_events,
                           " events (see n_used/n_events per-row for exact model Ns)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(l = 2, r = 2))

  p_combined <- p_upset + p_forest + p_pvalue + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.4, 0.4))

  list(rows = panel_rows, plot = p_combined, n = n_total, n_events = n_events)
}


build_analyte_TOA_interaction_panel <- function(data, analyte_var,
                                                 covariate_vars, covariate_labels,
                                                 contrast_label,
                                                 max_size = length(covariate_vars),
                                                 color_low = "turquoise3", color_high = "purple4") {

  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[analyte_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(analyte_rank = rank(.data[[analyte_var]], ties.method = "average"))

  if (length(covariate_vars) == 0 || nrow(data) < 5) {
    return(list(rows = data.frame(), plot = NULL))
  }

  term_of_interest <- "analyte_rank"

  interaction_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(1:max_size, function(k) {

    combo_list <- utils::combn(covariate_vars, k, simplify = FALSE)

    purrr::map_dfr(combo_list, function(covs) {

      rhs <- paste(paste0("analyte_rank * ", covs), collapse = " + ")

      fit <- tryCatch(
        survival::coxph(
          stats::as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status) ~ ", rhs)),
          data = data
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL,
        warning = function(w) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

      fit_tidy <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
      n_used <- nrow(stats::model.frame(fit))
      n_ev   <- sum(data$Infection_status[rownames(data) %in% rownames(stats::model.frame(fit))], na.rm = TRUE)

      purrr::map_dfr(covs, function(cov) {

        interaction_prefix <- paste0(term_of_interest, ":", cov)
        matched_rows <- fit_tidy %>% dplyr::filter(startsWith(term, interaction_prefix))
        if (nrow(matched_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

        matched_rows %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            covariate    = unname(covariate_labels[cov]),
            active_cov   = cov,
            covs_raw     = list(covs),
            n_covariates = length(covs),
            n_used       = n_used,
            n_events     = n_ev,
            p_label      = dplyr::if_else(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p.value, digits = 3, format = "f")),
            sig          = p.value < 0.05
          )
      })
    })
  })

  if (nrow(interaction_rows) == 0) return(list(rows = data.frame(), plot = NULL))

  interaction_rows <- interaction_rows %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sort_key = paste(as.integer(covariate_vars %in% covs_raw), collapse = "")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(active_cov_order = match(active_cov, covariate_vars)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(active_cov_order, n_covariates, dplyr::desc(sort_key)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      row_label = paste0(covariate, " | model ", dplyr::row_number()),
      row_label = factor(row_label, rev(unique(row_label))),
      row_id    = as.integer(row_label)
    )

  covariate_color_vec <- setNames(grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(color_low, color_high))(length(covariate_vars)), covariate_vars)

  upset_long <- interaction_rows %>%
    dplyr::select(row_label, row_id, covs_raw, active_cov) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(covariate_col = list(covariate_vars)) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(covariate_col) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_member = covariate_col %in% covs_raw, is_active = covariate_col == active_cov) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      covariate_label = factor(covariate_labels[covariate_col], levels = covariate_labels[covariate_vars]),
      dot_color = ifelse(is_active, unname(covariate_color_vec[covariate_col]), NA_character_)
    )

  upset_segments <- upset_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_member) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(row_id, row_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(x_min = min(as.integer(covariate_label)), x_max = max(as.integer(covariate_label)), .groups = "drop")

  p_upset <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = upset_long, aes(x = covariate_label, y = row_label), color = "grey85", size = 2.2) +
    geom_segment(data = upset_segments, aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, y = row_label, yend = row_label), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(upset_long, is_member, !is_active), aes(x = covariate_label, y = row_label), color = "grey20", size = 2.6) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(upset_long, is_active), aes(x = covariate_label, y = row_label, color = dot_color), size = 3.4) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93"), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 7, angle = 40, hjust = 0),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(r = 2))

  p_pvalue <- ggplot(interaction_rows, aes(x = 1, y = row_label)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = p_label), size = 3, hjust = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.9, 1.1), breaks = NULL) +
    labs(x = "p-value", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(l = 2))

  p_forest <- ggplot(interaction_rows, aes(x = estimate, y = row_label, color = active_cov)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.2) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "p < 0.05", values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Interaction\ncovariate", values = covariate_color_vec,
                       breaks = covariate_vars, labels = unname(covariate_labels[covariate_vars])) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
    labs(x = "Interaction HR (log scale)", y = NULL,
         title = paste0(contrast_label, ": does a covariate modify the analyte-TOA relationship?"),
         subtitle = paste0(nrow(interaction_rows), " interaction terms across univariate + joint models (up to ", max_size,
                           " simultaneous interactions). CAUTION: n/events shown per-row -- interaction terms are the least-powered estimate in this analysis.")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(l = 2, r = 2))

  p_combined <- p_upset + p_forest + p_pvalue + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.4, 0.4))

  list(rows = interaction_rows, plot = p_combined)
}

```

### Model fitting by category {.tabset} 

```{r vsTOA_cov_run_all, results='asis'}

## ============================================================
## Driver: for every category x analyte x dataset_type x platform,
## look up the testable covariate set and fit both panels.
## ============================================================

TOAcov_all_results <- list()
TOAcov_all_results_interaction <- list()

for (curr_category in names(nonTOA_category_vars)) {

  cat("#### ", curr_category, " {.tabset}\n\n")

  analytes <- nonTOA_category_vars[[curr_category]]

  for (curr_analyte in analytes) {

    data_list <- build_analyte_TOAcov_data(curr_analyte)
    if (length(data_list) == 0) next

    for (curr_ds in names(data_list)) {

      df_ds <- data_list[[curr_ds]]

      for (plat in levels(TOAcov_animal_base$Platform)) {

        df_p <- dplyr::filter(df_ds, Platform == plat)
        if (nrow(df_p) == 0) next

        covs_use <- get_TOAcov_covariate_set(curr_analyte, curr_ds, plat)

        contrast_label <- paste0(curr_analyte, " (", curr_ds, "), ", TOAcov_platform_labels[plat])

        main_res <- build_analyte_TOA_panel(df_p, "value", covs_use, covariate_labels_TOAcov, contrast_label)

        if (nrow(main_res$rows) > 0) {
          TOAcov_all_results[[length(TOAcov_all_results) + 1]] <- main_res$rows %>%
            dplyr::mutate(category = curr_category, analyte = curr_analyte,
                          dataset_type = curr_ds, platform = plat)
        }

        if (length(covs_use) > 0) {
          int_res <- build_analyte_TOA_interaction_panel(df_p, "value", covs_use, covariate_labels_TOAcov, contrast_label)
          if (nrow(int_res$rows) > 0) {
            TOAcov_all_results_interaction[[length(TOAcov_all_results_interaction) + 1]] <- int_res$rows %>%
              dplyr::mutate(category = curr_category, analyte = curr_analyte,
                            dataset_type = curr_ds, platform = plat)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  cat("(model fitting complete for this category -- see classification table below for results)\n\n")
}

TOAcov_results_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(TOAcov_all_results)
TOAcov_results_interaction_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(TOAcov_all_results_interaction)

list_of_stats[["vsTOAcov_main"]] <- TOAcov_results_combined
list_of_stats[["vsTOAcov_interaction"]] <- TOAcov_results_interaction_combined
```

```{r vsTOA_cov_classification}

## ============================================================
## PART 3: Four-way classification, computed SEPARATELY PER PLATFORM.
## Identical logic to analyte_summary_long's INDEPENDENT / CONFOUNDED
## / MASKED / CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED scheme.
## ============================================================

alpha <- 0.05

summarize_TOA_main_stability <- function(df) {
  unadj <- df %>% dplyr::filter(adjustment == "Unadjusted")
  adj   <- df %>% dplyr::filter(adjustment != "Unadjusted")
  if (nrow(unadj) == 0) return(NULL)

  sig_unadj  <- unadj$p.value[1] < alpha
  sign_unadj <- sign(unadj$estimate[1] - 1)

  if (nrow(adj) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(main_est_unadj = unadj$estimate[1], main_p_unadj = unadj$p.value[1],
                      main_p_min = NA, main_p_max = NA, n_adj_models = 0,
                      n_main_changed = 0, main_stable = TRUE))
  }

  sig_adj <- adj$p.value < alpha
  status_change <- sig_adj != sig_unadj
  sign_change   <- sig_unadj & sig_adj & (sign(adj$estimate - 1) != sign_unadj)
  n_changed <- sum(status_change | sign_change, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    main_est_unadj = unadj$estimate[1], main_p_unadj = unadj$p.value[1],
    main_p_min = min(adj$p.value, na.rm = TRUE), main_p_max = max(adj$p.value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_adj_models = nrow(adj), n_main_changed = n_changed, main_stable = n_changed == 0
  )
}

build_TOAcov_summary_long <- function() {

  combos <- TOAcov_results_combined %>% dplyr::distinct(category, analyte, dataset_type, platform)

  purrr::pmap_dfr(combos, function(category, analyte, dataset_type, platform) {

    df_main <- TOAcov_results_combined %>%
      dplyr::filter(analyte == !!analyte, dataset_type == !!dataset_type, platform == !!platform)
    df_int  <- TOAcov_results_interaction_combined %>%
      dplyr::filter(analyte == !!analyte, dataset_type == !!dataset_type, platform == !!platform)

    main_summ <- summarize_TOA_main_stability(df_main)
    if (is.null(main_summ)) return(NULL)

    any_cov_sig_interaction <- if (nrow(df_int) > 0) any(df_int$p.value < alpha, na.rm = TRUE) else FALSE

    sig_covs <- if (any_cov_sig_interaction) {
      df_int %>% dplyr::filter(p.value < alpha) %>% dplyr::pull(covariate) %>% unique() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
    } else { "" }

    n_full <- TOAcov_testability_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(analyte == !!analyte, dataset_type == !!dataset_type, platform == !!platform)

    dplyr::bind_cols(
      data.frame(category = category, analyte = analyte, dataset_type = dataset_type, platform = platform,
                 n_animals = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_animals[1] else NA,
                 n_events  = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_events[1]  else NA,
                 n_male    = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_male[1]    else NA,
                 n_female  = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_female[1]  else NA,
                 n_alum    = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_alum[1]    else NA,
                 n_alfqa   = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$n_alfqa[1]   else NA,
                 previously_reported = if (nrow(n_full) > 0) n_full$previously_reported[1] else FALSE,
                 any_cov_sig_interaction = any_cov_sig_interaction,
                 sig_interaction_covariates = sig_covs),
      main_summ
    )
  })
}

TOAcov_summary_long <- build_TOAcov_summary_long() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    main_unstable = (main_stable %in% FALSE),
    model_summary = dplyr::case_when(
      !main_unstable & !any_cov_sig_interaction ~ "INDEPENDENT",
      !main_unstable &  any_cov_sig_interaction ~ "MASKED",
       main_unstable &  any_cov_sig_interaction ~ "CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED",
      TRUE                                      ~ "CONFOUNDED"
    ),
    platform_label = TOAcov_platform_labels[platform],
    newly_surfaced_masked = model_summary %in% c("MASKED", "CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED") & !previously_reported
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-main_unstable)

list_of_stats[["vsTOAcov_classification"]] <- TOAcov_summary_long

```


```{r vsTOA_cov_classification_display, results='asis'}

cat("### vsTOA covariate-adjusted classification {.tabset}\n\n")

cat("**Category definitions** (computed separately within each platform):\n\n")
cat("- **INDEPENDENT**: relationship stable across adjustment, no significant interaction term.\n")
cat("- **CONFOUNDED**: main-effect significance/sign changes across adjustment subsets, no significant interaction.\n")
cat("- **MASKED**: main effect stable, BUT >=1 covariate shows a significant interaction term -- relationship genuinely differs by covariate level even though the pooled estimate looks stable. **These are the analytes most likely to represent previously-missed TOA relationships if previously_reported = FALSE.**\n")
cat("- **CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED**: both unstable AND has a significant interaction term -- most fragile case.\n\n")

cat("**previously_reported**: TRUE if this analyte/platform was already flagged by the systematic unadjusted Spearman test above (not manuscript text). **newly_surfaced_masked = TRUE is the headline deliverable** -- MASKED/CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED analytes that were NOT already significant unadjusted.\n\n")

for (curr_plat in names(TOAcov_platform_labels)) {

  cat("#### ", TOAcov_platform_labels[curr_plat], " {.tabset}\n\n")

  cat("##### Classification counts\n\n")

  ### flextable won't work in the loop
  TOAcov_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(platform == curr_plat) %>%
    dplyr::count(model_summary, previously_reported) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = previously_reported, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`previously reported` = `TRUE`, `NOT previously reported (new)` = `FALSE`) %>%
    flextable::flextable() %>%
    flextable::theme_zebra() %>%
    print()

  cat("\n\n")

  cat("##### Full table\n\n")

  TOAcov_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(platform == curr_plat) %>%
    dplyr::select(category, analyte, dataset_type, n_animals, n_events, n_male, n_female,
                  n_alum, n_alfqa, model_summary,
                  previously_reported, newly_surfaced_masked, sig_interaction_covariates,
                  main_est_unadj, main_p_unadj, main_p_min, main_p_max) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(newly_surfaced_masked), model_summary) %>%
    DT::datatable(
      extensions = 'Buttons', filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                     buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                     iDisplayLength = 25,
                     lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, -1), c(10, 25, 50, "All")))
    ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = "model_summary",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        c("INDEPENDENT", "CONFOUNDED", "MASKED", "CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED"),
        c("lightgreen", "lightyellow", "orange", "tomato")
      )
    ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = "newly_surfaced_masked",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("gold", "white")),
      fontWeight = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("bold", "normal"))
    ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = "n_events",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(5, 10), c("tomato", "lightyellow", "lightgreen"))
    ) %>%
    htmltools::tagList() %>%
    print()

  cat("\n\n")

  cat("##### Newly surfaced (masked, not previously reported)\n\n")

  newly_df <- TOAcov_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(platform == curr_plat, newly_surfaced_masked)

  if (nrow(newly_df) == 0) {
    cat("No newly-surfaced masked/confounded-modified analytes for ", TOAcov_platform_labels[curr_plat], ".\n\n")
  } else {
    newly_df %>%
      dplyr::select(category, analyte, dataset_type, n_animals, n_events, n_male, n_female,
                    n_alum, n_alfqa, model_summary,
                    sig_interaction_covariates, main_est_unadj, main_p_unadj) %>%
      DT::datatable(
        extensions = 'Buttons', rownames = FALSE,
        options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                       iDisplayLength = 25)
      ) %>%
      htmltools::tagList() %>%
      print()
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
