### Stratified follow-up for significant interactions {.tabset}

```{r vsTOA_cov_stratified_followup}

## ============================================================
## SYSTEMATIC (not hand-picked) stratified follow-up.
##
## Source of truth is TOAcov_summary_long, which was itself built from
## the full interaction panel fit over every analyte x dataset_type x
## platform (vsTOA_cov_run_all / vsTOA_cov_classification) -- nothing
## here is manually selected. For every row classified MASKED or
## CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED, sig_interaction_covariates already names
## exactly which covariate(s) had a significant interaction term; for
## each one we refit the analyte-vs-TOA relationship split by that
## covariate:
##   - Sex / Adjuvant (categorical): re-rank the analyte WITHIN each
##     level and fit Surv ~ analyte_rank, separately per level.
##   - weight_c / ageChall_c (continuous): evaluate the already-fit
##     analyte_rank * covariate interaction model's simple slope at
##     the covariate's 10th and 90th percentile (low/high "stratum").
## ============================================================

strat_level_orders_vsTOA <- list(
  Sex      = c("Male", "Female"),
  Adjuvant = c("Alum", "ALFQA")
)

run_stratified_TOA_test <- function(data, analyte_var, strat_var) {

  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[analyte_var]]))
  strata <- intersect(strat_level_orders_vsTOA[[strat_var]], unique(as.character(data[[strat_var]])))

  purrr::map_dfr(strata, function(s) {

    df_s <- dplyr::filter(data, .data[[strat_var]] == s)

    if (nrow(df_s) < 5 || sum(df_s$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(stratum = s, n = nrow(df_s), n_events = sum(df_s$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
                        estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA,
                        note = "insufficient n/events in this stratum"))
    }

    df_s <- df_s %>% dplyr::mutate(analyte_rank_s = rank(.data[[analyte_var]], ties.method = "average"))

    fit <- tryCatch(
      survival::coxph(survival::Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status) ~ analyte_rank_s, data = df_s),
      error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit)) {
      return(data.frame(stratum = s, n = nrow(df_s), n_events = sum(df_s$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
                        estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA,
                        note = "model did not converge"))
    }

    coef_row <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == "analyte_rank_s")

    data.frame(stratum = s, n = nrow(df_s), n_events = sum(df_s$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
              estimate = coef_row$estimate, conf.low = coef_row$conf.low,
              conf.high = coef_row$conf.high, p.value = coef_row$p.value, note = "")
  })
}

## --------------------------------------------------------
## Continuous covariate "validation" of a significant interaction =
## report the interaction coefficient ITSELF (analyte_rank:covariate),
## one value per covariate -- this is the direct TOA analogue of
## run_continuous_interaction_summary() in the nonTOA pipeline, which
## also just reports the raw Platform:covariate interaction
## coefficient as the heatmap column value (NOT a low/high evaluation
## -- that richer curve lives in plot_continuous_interaction() as a
## separate, standalone diagnostic plot, not the heatmap tile itself).
## --------------------------------------------------------
run_continuous_TOA_slope <- function(data, analyte_var, covariate_var) {

  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[analyte_var]]), !is.na(.data[[covariate_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(analyte_rank = rank(.data[[analyte_var]], ties.method = "average"))

  if (nrow(data) < 5 || sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(stratum = "slope", n = nrow(data),
                      n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
                      estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA,
                      note = "insufficient n/events"))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    survival::coxph(
      stats::as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(TOA_adj, Infection_status) ~ analyte_rank * ", covariate_var)),
      data = data
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(stratum = "slope", n = nrow(data),
                      n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
                      estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA,
                      note = "model did not converge"))
  }

  int_term <- paste0("analyte_rank:", covariate_var)
  if (!int_term %in% names(coef(fit))) {
    return(data.frame(stratum = "slope", n = nrow(data),
                      n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
                      estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA,
                      note = "interaction term not estimable"))
  }

  coef_row <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == int_term)

  data.frame(stratum = "slope", n = nrow(data),
            n_events = sum(data$Infection_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            estimate = coef_row$estimate, conf.low = coef_row$conf.low,
            conf.high = coef_row$conf.high, p.value = coef_row$p.value, note = "")
}

## --------------------------------------------------------
## Driver: pull every MASKED/CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED row directly from
## TOAcov_summary_long (systematic, no manual curation), and for each
## covariate named in that row's own sig_interaction_covariates,
## refit the appropriate stratified/simple-slope model.
## --------------------------------------------------------
masked_or_confmod <- TOAcov_summary_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(model_summary %in% c("MASKED", "CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED"))

label_to_var <- setNames(names(covariate_labels_TOAcov), covariate_labels_TOAcov)

vsTOA_followup_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(masked_or_confmod$analyte, masked_or_confmod$dataset_type, masked_or_confmod$platform,
       masked_or_confmod$sig_interaction_covariates),
  function(analyte, ds_type, plat, sig_covs_str) {

    if (is.na(sig_covs_str) || sig_covs_str == "") return(NULL)

    sig_covs <- trimws(strsplit(sig_covs_str, ",")[[1]])
    sig_covs_var <- unname(label_to_var[sig_covs])
    sig_covs_var <- sig_covs_var[!is.na(sig_covs_var)]

    data_list <- build_analyte_TOAcov_data(analyte)
    if (!ds_type %in% names(data_list)) return(NULL)
    df_p <- dplyr::filter(data_list[[ds_type]], Platform == plat)
    if (nrow(df_p) == 0) return(NULL)

    purrr::map_dfr(sig_covs_var, function(cov) {

if (cov %in% c("Sex", "Adjuvant")) {
        res <- run_stratified_TOA_test(df_p, "value", cov)
      } else {
        res <- run_continuous_TOA_slope(df_p, "value", cov)
      }
      if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)

      res %>% dplyr::mutate(analyte = analyte, dataset_type = ds_type, platform = plat, strat_var = cov)
    })
  }
)

list_of_stats[["vsTOAcov_stratified_followup"]] <- vsTOA_followup_results

```

```{r vsTOA_cov_interaction_heatmap, results='asis', fig.width=17, fig.height=20}

## ============================================================
## Visual analogue of "summary 4-categories > Interaction term sig"
## (heatmapSummary), built from the SYSTEMATIC stratified follow-up.
## Two versions are rendered:
##   1. Unfiltered -- every MASKED/CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED analyte/platform
##   2. Filtered -- rows dropped if BOTH (a) the unadjusted pooled
##      Spearman was not significant (spearman_dir %in% c("not sig",
##      "not tested")), AND (b) none of that row's stratified/slope
##      tiles reached p<0.05 (no stars anywhere in that row). I.e. a
##      row survives if it has a significant unadjusted Spearman OR at
##      least one significant stratified/slope result.
## ============================================================

if (nrow(vsTOA_followup_results) == 0) {

  cat("No analytes classified as MASKED or CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED with a fittable stratified/simple-slope follow-up -- heatmap omitted.\n\n")

} else {

  ## ---- shared data prep (same for both plot versions) ----
  heat_df_base <- vsTOA_followup_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      row_lab = paste(analyte, dataset_type, platform, sep = " | "),
      log_hr  = log(estimate),
      stars   = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(p.value) ~ "",
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      col_lab    = paste0(strat_var, ": ", stratum),
      panel_type = dplyr::if_else(strat_var %in% c("Sex", "Adjuvant"), "categorical", "continuous")
    )

  spearman_dir_lookup <- TOA_unadjusted_spearman %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      row_lab = paste(analyte, dataset_type, platform, sep = " | "),
      spearman_dir = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(spearman_p) ~ "not tested",
        spearman_p < 0.05 & spearman_R > 0 ~ "up",
        spearman_p < 0.05 & spearman_R < 0 ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "not sig"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(row_lab, spearman_dir, spearman_R, spearman_p)

  model_summary_lookup <- TOAcov_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row_lab = paste(analyte, dataset_type, platform, sep = " | ")) %>%
    dplyr::select(row_lab, model_summary, category, analyte, dataset_type, platform)

  row_meta_base <- model_summary_lookup %>%
    dplyr::left_join(spearman_dir_lookup, by = "row_lab") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      spearman_dir = dplyr::coalesce(spearman_dir, "not tested"),
      platform_label = TOAcov_platform_labels[platform],
      dataset_type = factor(dataset_type, levels = c("Baseline", "Post", "Delta", "FC"))
    )

  heat_df_base <- heat_df_base %>%
    dplyr::left_join(row_meta_base %>% dplyr::select(row_lab, spearman_dir, model_summary, category, platform_label),
                     by = "row_lab")

  ## ---- per-row "any significant evidence" flag, used by the filtered
  ## version: a row is kept if its unadjusted Spearman was significant
  ## OR at least one of its stratified/slope tiles has stars != "" ----
  row_sig_flags <- heat_df_base %>%
    dplyr::group_by(row_lab) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(any_tile_sig = any(stars != ""), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(spearman_dir_lookup %>% dplyr::select(row_lab, spearman_dir), by = "row_lab") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      spearman_sig = spearman_dir %in% c("up", "down"),
      keep_row = any_tile_sig | spearman_sig
    )

  col_levels_cat  <- unlist(lapply(c("Sex", "Adjuvant"), function(v)
    if (!is.null(strat_level_orders_vsTOA[[v]])) paste0(v, ": ", strat_level_orders_vsTOA[[v]]) else NULL))
  col_levels_cont <- c("weight_c: slope", "ageChall_c: slope")
  all_col_levels <- c(col_levels_cat, col_levels_cont)

  model_summary_colors <- c(MASKED = "orange", CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED = "tomato")
  spearman_dir_colors  <- c(up = "red2", down = "blue2", `not sig` = "grey70", `not tested` = "white")
  timepoint_colors <- c(
    "Baseline" = "#FFFFB2",
    "Post"     = "#D9D95C",
    "Delta"    = "#A6A600",
    "FC"       = "#4D4D00"
  )

  ## --------------------------------------------------------
  ## Build one complete heatmap (row-ordering, spacers, labels, plots)
  ## from a given heat_df/row_meta_base, optionally restricted to rows
  ## in keep_row_labs. Wrapped as a function so unfiltered/filtered
  ## versions share identical logic rather than being copy-pasted.
  ## --------------------------------------------------------
  build_vsTOA_heatmap <- function(heat_df, row_meta, keep_row_labs = NULL, title_suffix = "") {

    if (!is.null(keep_row_labs)) {
      heat_df  <- dplyr::filter(heat_df,  row_lab %in% keep_row_labs)
      row_meta <- dplyr::filter(row_meta, row_lab %in% keep_row_labs)
    }

    if (nrow(row_meta) == 0) return(NULL)

platform_order <- names(TOAcov_platform_labels)
    spearman_order <- c("up", "down", "not sig", "not tested")

    row_order_df <- heat_df %>%
      dplyr::distinct(row_lab, platform, platform_label, category, analyte, dataset_type, spearman_dir) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        platform = factor(platform, levels = platform_order),
        spearman_dir = factor(spearman_dir, levels = spearman_order),
        dataset_type = factor(dataset_type, levels = c("Baseline", "Post", "Delta", "FC"))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(platform, spearman_dir, category, analyte, dataset_type)

    new_row_levels <- rev(row_order_df$row_lab)

    spacer_levels <- character(0)
    spearman_change_rowidx <- integer(0)
    n <- length(new_row_levels)

    lookup_ord <- row_order_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(match(as.character(new_row_levels), row_lab))

    stopifnot(identical(as.character(lookup_ord$row_lab), as.character(new_row_levels)))

    platform_vals <- as.character(lookup_ord$platform)
    spearman_vals <- as.character(lookup_ord$spearman_dir)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, as.character(new_row_levels[i]))
      if (i < n && platform_vals[i] != platform_vals[i + 1]) {
        ## platform changed -> thick line + spacer row
        spacer_levels <- c(spacer_levels, paste0("__spacer__", i))
      } else if (i < n && spearman_vals[i] != spearman_vals[i + 1]) {
        ## spearman_dir group changed within same platform -> medium line
        spearman_change_rowidx <- c(spearman_change_rowidx, length(spacer_levels))
      }
    }

    stopifnot(length(unique(spacer_levels)) == length(spacer_levels))

    spacer_ypos <- which(grepl("^__spacer__", spacer_levels))
    spearman_spacer_ypos <- spearman_change_rowidx + 0.5

    heat_df <- heat_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = factor(as.character(row_lab), levels = spacer_levels))

    row_meta_full <- data.frame(row_lab = spacer_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(row_meta %>% dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)), by = "row_lab") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        row_lab = factor(row_lab, levels = spacer_levels),
        is_spacer = grepl("^__spacer__", as.character(row_lab))
      )

## analyte label blocks, keyed by CONTIGUOUS RUN (not raw analyte
    ## name) -- the same analyte can appear non-contiguously across
    ## platform blocks, so grouping by name alone would misplace labels
    row_meta_full <- row_meta_full %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(row_lab) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .analyte_chr = as.character(analyte),
        run_id = cumsum(.analyte_chr != dplyr::lag(.analyte_chr, default = dplyr::first(.analyte_chr)) | dplyr::row_number() == 1)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-.analyte_chr) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dplyr::filter(row_meta_full, is_spacer)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(row_lab = factor(as.character(row_lab), levels = spacer_levels)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(row_lab)

    analyte_label_df <- row_meta_full %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(run_id, analyte) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(y_mid = mean(range(y)), .groups = "drop")

    max_label_width <- max(nchar(as.character(analyte_label_df$analyte)), na.rm = TRUE)

    ## pale thin-line y-positions at EVERY analyte-block boundary (not
    ## just category boundaries) -- derived from run_id transitions, so
    ## it's guaranteed consistent with where analyte_label_df actually
    ## places its labels, rather than re-deriving boundaries separately
    ## from analyte name comparisons (which would break the same way
    ## the earlier bug did, for repeated analyte names across platforms)
    non_spacer_rows <- row_meta_full %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(y)

    run_boundaries <- non_spacer_rows %>%
      dplyr::group_by(run_id) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(y_max = max(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::filter(run_id != max(non_spacer_rows$run_id))  ## drop the very last run (no boundary after it)

    analyte_spacer_ypos <- run_boundaries$y_max + 0.5

    platform_label_df <- row_meta_full %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is_spacer) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y = as.numeric(row_lab)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(platform_label) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(y_mid = mean(range(y)), .groups = "drop")
    
    ## ---- untestable-tile slash segments, ported from heatmapSummary()'s
    ## build_slash_segments(), but sourced from TOAcov_testability_table
    ## (per analyte/dataset_type/platform) rather than
    ## category_covariate_untestable (per category, Platform-contrast
    ## testability) -- different question, different source table. ----
    col_to_covariate <- c(
      setNames(rep("Sex_testable", length(strat_level_orders_vsTOA[["Sex"]])),
               paste0("Sex: ", strat_level_orders_vsTOA[["Sex"]])),
      setNames(rep("Adjuvant_testable", length(strat_level_orders_vsTOA[["Adjuvant"]])),
               paste0("Adjuvant: ", strat_level_orders_vsTOA[["Adjuvant"]])),
      "weight_c: slope"   = "Weight_testable",
      "ageChall_c: slope" = "Age_testable"
    )



    heat_plot_df <- tidyr::crossing(row_lab = spacer_levels, col_lab = all_col_levels) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(heat_df %>% dplyr::select(row_lab, col_lab, log_hr, stars, estimate, p.value, panel_type) %>%
                         dplyr::mutate(row_lab = as.character(row_lab)),
                       by = c("row_lab", "col_lab")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        row_lab = factor(row_lab, levels = spacer_levels),
        col_lab = factor(col_lab, levels = all_col_levels),
        stars   = dplyr::coalesce(stars, ""),
        panel_type = dplyr::if_else(col_lab %in% col_levels_cat, "categorical", "continuous")
      )

    
    

    
    
    lim_cat  <- max(abs(heat_plot_df$log_hr[heat_plot_df$panel_type == "categorical"]), na.rm = TRUE)
    lim_cont <- max(abs(heat_plot_df$log_hr[heat_plot_df$panel_type == "continuous"]), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(lim_cat)  || lim_cat  == 0) lim_cat  <- 1
    if (!is.finite(lim_cont) || lim_cont == 0) lim_cont <- 1

p_sidebar <- ggplot(row_meta_full) +
      geom_tile(aes(x = "Classification", y = row_lab, fill = model_summary), width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = model_summary_colors, name = "Classification", na.value = "white") +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_tile(aes(x = "Spearman dir", y = row_lab, fill = spearman_dir), width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = spearman_dir_colors, name = "Unadjusted\nSpearman dir", na.value = "white") +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_tile(aes(x = "Timepoint", y = row_lab, fill = dataset_type), width = 0.9, height = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors, name = "Timepoint", na.value = "white", drop = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = analyte_label_df, aes(x = "label", y = y_mid, label = analyte),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
      geom_text(data = platform_label_df, aes(x = "label", y = y_mid, label = platform_label),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = c("label", "Classification", "Spearman dir", "Timepoint"),
                       expand = expansion(add = c(max_label_width * 0.17, 0.6))) +
      scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spearman_spacer_ypos, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      theme_void() +
      theme(legend.position = "left", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

    p_main <- ggplot() +
      geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(heat_plot_df, panel_type == "categorical"),
               aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, fill = log_hr), color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +
      geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(heat_plot_df, panel_type == "categorical"),
               aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, label = stars), size = 6, vjust = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                           midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim_cat, lim_cat), na.value = "grey70",
                           name = "log(HR)\n(within stratum,\nSex/Adjuvant)") +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(heat_plot_df, panel_type == "continuous"),
               aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, fill = log_hr), color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +
      geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(heat_plot_df, panel_type == "continuous"),
               aes(x = col_lab, y = row_lab, label = stars), size = 6, vjust = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1B7837", mid = "white", high = "darkorange",
                           midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim_cont, lim_cont), na.value = "grey70",
                           name = "log(interaction HR)\nper unit\n(Weight/Age)") +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spacer_ypos, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = spearman_spacer_ypos, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = analyte_spacer_ypos, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
           title = paste0("Analyte-TOA relationships with a significant covariate interaction (MASKED / CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED)", title_suffix),
           subtitle = paste0(
        "Rows sorted: Platform (thick line) -> unadjusted Spearman direction (medium line: up/down/not sig) -> Category -> Analyte (thin line) -> dataset_type.\n",
        "Sex/Adjuvant columns: analyte-vs-TOA HR refit SEPARATELY within each real subgroup.\n",
        "Weight/Age columns: the analyte_rank:covariate interaction coefficient itself.\n",
        "* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001. Grey = not applicable or not fittable. "
      )
      )+
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))
    
    
    
    patchwork::wrap_plots(p_sidebar, p_main, ncol = 2, widths = c(1.8, 1))
  }

  cat("#### Unfiltered (all MASKED / CONFOUNDED_MODIFIED rows)\n\n")

  combined_all <- build_vsTOA_heatmap(heat_df_base, row_meta_base, keep_row_labs = NULL)
  plot(combined_all)

  cat("\n\n")

  cat("#### Filtered (only rows with >=1 significant result)\n\n")

  cat("Rows dropped here had a non-significant unadjusted Spearman AND no significant stratified/slope result in any column -- i.e. nothing in the row reached p<0.05 anywhere.\n\n")

  rows_to_keep <- row_sig_flags %>% dplyr::filter(keep_row) %>% dplyr::pull(row_lab)

  combined_filtered <- build_vsTOA_heatmap(heat_df_base, row_meta_base, keep_row_labs = rows_to_keep,
                                           title_suffix = " -- filtered to rows with >=1 significant result")

  if (is.null(combined_filtered)) {
    cat("No rows had any significant result (unadjusted Spearman or stratified/slope test) -- filtered heatmap omitted.\n\n")
  } else {
    plot(combined_filtered)
  }

  cat("\n\n")

  cat("#### Underlying stratified/simple-slope follow-up table\n\n")

  vsTOA_followup_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), ~round(.x, 3)),
                 p.value = signif(p.value, 3)) %>%
    DT::datatable(
      extensions = 'Buttons', filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                     iDisplayLength = 25)
    ) %>%
    htmltools::tagList() %>%
    print()

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r vsTOAsummary}
############ collect only vsTOA sig
TOA_tabs <- names(list_of_stats)[grepl("TOA",names(list_of_stats))]
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[!grepl("Baseline",TOA_tabs)] ### remove since redundant
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[!grepl("VsSelf",TOA_tabs)] ### remove since redundant
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[!grepl("nonTOA",TOA_tabs)] ### remove Cox/lm covariate results (no raw_p column)

## extra safety net: only keep tabs that actually have a raw_p column,
## in case other unrelated tables ever slip through the name-matching above
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[sapply(TOA_tabs, function(nm) "raw_p" %in% colnames(list_of_stats[[nm]]))]

vsTOA_df <- data.frame()
for(curr_tab in TOA_tabs){
  
  curr_df <- list_of_stats[[paste0(curr_tab)]] %>%
    ### trim to sig
    dplyr::filter(raw_p < 0.05) %>%
    ### add tab name as overall group
    dplyr::mutate(figure = paste0(curr_tab),
                  ## also add am/fc/de to rowname
                  ds = str_after_last(curr_tab,"_"),
                  ds = str_replace_all(str_replace_all(ds,"am","amount"),"de","delta"),
                  var_comp_time_ds = paste0(rowname,"___",ds))
  
  ### add to data.frame
  vsTOA_df <- rbind(vsTOA_df, curr_df)
  
}

#### collect data: columns are assay (var_comp_time_ds_group), rows are animals (all per both groups)
data_for_comp <- phen_long %>%
  ### trim to only columns need
  dplyr::select(studyLetterForMS,Group_ignoreALFQA,Sample_ID,Time_Point,Specimen,variable,TOA_adj,amount,FC,delta) %>%
  ### make longer by amount/FC/delta
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("amount","FC","delta"), names_to = "ds", values_to = "value") %>%
  ### add var_comp_time to match vsTOA_df rowname
  dplyr::mutate(var_comp_time_ds = paste0(variable, "__", Specimen, "__", Time_Point,"___",ds)) %>%
  ### trim to only vsTOA_df rowname
  dplyr::filter(var_comp_time_ds %in% unique(vsTOA_df$var_comp_time_ds)) %>%
  ## now make wider
  dplyr::select(-c(variable,Specimen,Time_Point,ds)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time_ds", values_from = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID))
```

### Summary Tables, p < `r paste0(ann_pval_level)` for at least one group {.tabset}

```{r TOAvars_extraTables, results='asis'}

#### regenerate df_for_alluvials with this cut
df_for_alluvials <- corr_df_combo %>%
  
  ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
  dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(pmax(var1, var2),"__vs__",pmin(var1, var2)),
                ### add dir
                dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                             ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                             "not_sig")) %>%
  
  ### also remove inverse duplicates
  dplyr::select(-c(var1,var2))  %>%
  unique() %>%
  
  
  dplyr::select(-c(raw_p,R_value))  %>%
  
  ### remove notsig for all groups
  ## make wider
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = "dir") %>%
  column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
  ## remove rows if all not_sig 
  dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(. != "not_sig")) %>%
  ## also remove if all na
  dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
  ### back to long
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Group", values_to = "dir") %>%
  ## factorize
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, names(group_colors_to_use)),
                dir = factor(dir, c("pos","not_sig","neg")),
                variable = factor(variable)) %>%
  ## arrange
  dplyr::arrange(dir, variable, Group) %>%
  #### add back in the p & R
  dplyr::left_join(corr_df_combo[,c("var1","var2","R_value","raw_p","Group")] %>%
                     dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                                   var1=NULL,
                                   var2=NULL),
                   by = c("variable","Group"))


df_of_plotted <- data.frame()

##### for each group
for(curr_group in unique(df_for_alluvials$Group)){
  
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_group, " {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  
  ##### for each dir
  for(curr_dir in c("pos","neg")){
    
    cat("##### ",paste0(curr_dir, " {.tabset}"),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    ##### trim to only vars NOT from the same compartment
    
    curr_df_for_alluvials <- df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(Plasma_both = ifelse(grepl("Plasma",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                           grepl("Plasma",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), 
                                         "both",
                                         "not"), 
                    ADCC_olink_both = ifelse(Plasma_both == "both",
                                             ifelse(grepl("ADCC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                                      grepl("ADCC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")),
                                                    "both",
                                                    ifelse(!grepl("ADCC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                                             !grepl("ADCC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")),
                                                           "both",
                                                           "not")),
                                             "not"),
                    PBMC_both = ifelse(grepl("PBMC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) & grepl("PBMC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), "both","not"), 
                    RM_both = ifelse(grepl("Rect_Muc",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) & grepl("Rect_Muc",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), "both","not")) 
    
    
    ###### only between different assay types
    cat("###### ",paste0(" Different Assaytype "),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    
    to_print1 <- curr_df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::filter(ADCC_olink_both == "not" & PBMC_both == "not" & RM_both == "not") %>% 
      #### now trim to group & dir
      dplyr::filter(as.character(Group) == curr_group & as.character(dir) == curr_dir) 
    
    
    to_print <- to_print1 %>%
      DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                    options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                   buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                   iDisplayLength = 25,
                                   lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                     c(10,25,50,"All"))))
    
    
    to_print
    #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
    
   
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    
    
    ##### among same assay types
    cat("###### ",paste0(" Same Assaytype "),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    
    to_print2 <- curr_df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::filter(!variable %in% to_print1$variable) %>% 
      #### now trim to group & dir
      dplyr::filter(as.character(Group) == curr_group & as.character(dir) == curr_dir) 
    
    
    to_print <- to_print2 %>%
      DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                    options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                   buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                   iDisplayLength = 25,
                                   lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                     c(10,25,50,"All"))))
    
    
    to_print
    #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
    
    
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    #### save
    df_of_plotted <- df_of_plotted %>% 
      rbind(to_print1 %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(group = paste0(curr_group),
                            dir = paste0(curr_dir),
                            samediff_assaytype = paste0("Diff_Assaytype"))) %>%
      rbind(to_print2 %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(group = paste0(curr_group),
                            dir = paste0(curr_dir),
                            samediff_assaytype = paste0("Same_Assaytype"))) 
    
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  
  
  
}






cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!


 list_of_plotted[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_",str_replace_all(ann_pval_level,"\\.","pt"))]] <- df_of_plotted

```
